title: Office Administrator with IT Support
description:
About Us

KLME LLP is a multi-jurisdictional law firm operating across the UAE (including ADGM and DIFC) and the wider region. Our lawyers work fully remotely, and the firm is built on flexibility, professionalism and reliability. We are modernising our back office around an integrated Microsoft 365 and SharePoint environment, supported by AI tools (Claude), to make document management, compliance tracking and client administration faster and easier to scale.

The Role

We are looking for a capable, trustworthy Office Administrator who is also comfortable handling the firm's everyday IT. Around 70% of the role is administration: supporting our lawyers, onboarding clients and keeping our remote operations running smoothly. The other 30% is hands-on IT support across Microsoft 365, SharePoint and Claude, our AI assistant.

You don't need to be a developer or IT engineer. We want an organised administrator who understands the basics of IT, picks up new tools quickly, and will grow with the firm as our systems develop.

Key Responsibilities

Office Administration (around 70%)

• Support onboarding of new clients and lawyers: gathering documents, setting up files and coordinating details

• Schedule meetings across time zones and manage shared inboxes professionally

• Assist lawyers with day-to-day admin (formatting, requests, follow-ups) and coordinate with vendors and service providers

• Keep the firm's SharePoint/OneDrive filing in order: set up new client and matter folders using our naming conventions and keep the master list of client and matter codes up to date

• Maintain the library of current templates (letters of engagement, terms of business, policies) so lawyers always use the latest version

• Track expiry of key documents (trade licences, IDs, KYC/AML documents) and flag upcoming renewals

IT Support (around 30%)

• Set up user accounts, shared mailboxes, folder access and work devices in Microsoft 365

• Help staff with everyday Outlook, OneDrive, Teams and MFA issues, and support the firm's MFA and access-control rollout

Nice to have

Working Arrangements & What We Offer

• A stable internet connection and a professional remote setup are required

title: Experienced Creative Strategist for a Beauty & Supplement E-Commerce
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Creative Strategist with a strong background in DTC/e-commerce, especially within beauty, skincare, and supplement brands.



This is a performance-focused role. We’re not only looking for someone who can create good-looking ads, but we want someone who understands what makes creatives spend, scale, and generate profitable ROAS.



What You’ll Do

- Develop fresh creative concepts and angles for our beauty and supplement products.

- Create video and static ad concepts for Meta.

- Write hooks, scripts, headlines, ad copy, and detailed creative briefs.

- Research competitors, customer reviews, trends, winning ads, and new opportunities.

- Develop concepts for different personas and stages of awareness.

- Analyze Spend, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, and other creative performance metrics.

- Identify winning creatives and develop iterations to help them scale.

- Work closely with our media buyers, editors, and designers.

- Ensure ad messaging and creative angles align with our landing/product pages.

- Understand how to communicate beauty and supplement benefits while keeping claims appropriate.



Who We’re Looking For

You must have previous experience as a Creative Strategist for DTC/e-commerce brands.



Experience with beauty/skincare and supplements is highly preferred.



You should understand:

- Meta/Facebook advertising

- Direct-response creative strategy

- UGC and static advertising

- Creative testing and iteration

- Customer psychology and market awareness

- Performance metrics, particularly spend and ROAS



⚠️ IMPORTANT: PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENT



Please do not apply without providing proof of previous creative performance.



Before we consider an application, you MUST attach a portfolio containing examples of ads/creatives you personally strategized.



For each relevant creative, please provide:

AD/CREATIVE

→ Your involvement/role

→ Total Ad Spend

→ ROAS

→ Other relevant results (CPA, CTR, purchases, etc., if available)

→ Proof of performance (screenshots from Meta Ads Manager or another verifiable source)



The Spend metric is especially important to us.



We want to see creatives that didn't simply achieve a strong ROAS on a small test budget; we want to understand how much spend the creative was able to handle while maintaining performance.



Applications that provide creative examples without Spend +, ROAS +, or supporting proof may not be considered.



Let us also know your hourly rate.

title: CRO & A/B Testing Specialist (E-commerce / DTC)
description:
We’re looking for an experienced CRO & A/B Testing Specialist to help us systematically improve the conversion rates of our DTC e-commerce stores.



You’ll be responsible for identifying conversion opportunities, developing testing hypotheses, launching A/B tests, analyzing results, and turning insights into actionable improvements across our landing pages, product pages, offers, bundles, and checkout funnel.



Key Responsibilities

Analyze website and funnel performance to identify conversion bottlenecks and opportunities.

Develop a structured CRO roadmap and A/B testing strategy.

Build, launch, and manage A/B tests using Intelligems or similar experimentation platforms.

Test elements such as:

Pricing and offers

Bundles and quantity breaks

Subscription vs. one-time purchase offers

Product page layouts

Headlines, copy, CTAs, and creative

Upsells and cross-sells

Landing page structures

Determine appropriate test duration, sample size, and statistical significance.

Analyze test results beyond just CVR, including AOV, RPV, revenue, subscription take rate, and profitability.

Document learnings and recommend which winning tests should be rolled out.

Work closely with our media buying, creative, and development teams.

Continuously develop new testing hypotheses based on customer behavior and performance data.



Requirements

Proven experience in CRO and A/B testing for DTC/e-commerce brands.

Hands-on experience with Intelligems or similar tools.

Strong understanding of Shopify conversion funnels.

Experience testing pricing, bundles, subscriptions, PDPs, and landing pages.

Strong analytical skills and understanding of statistical significance.

Comfortable interpreting data and translating it into clear actions.

Able to show examples of previous tests and measurable improvements.



To apply, please send us your portfolio so we can see your previous work, let us know the tools you used for testing, and let us know your rate.

title: AI Video Editor (Full-Time)
description:
We are hiring a creative, hardworking, and highly trainable AI Video Editor to join our growing YouTube media company.



We produce faceless YouTube Shorts and long-form videos across various niches, including science, history, entertainment, and storytelling.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply generates AI videos using code or one-click automation tools.



We need someone who can take AI-generated footage and professionally edit it into entertaining, polished, high-retention videos.



More importantly, we want someone who listens carefully, follows instructions, accepts feedback, and is willing to learn and improve.



You do not need to be the world's best editor. We are happy to train the right person.



Responsibilities

Edit YouTube Shorts and long-form videos.

Generate AI footage using tools such as Google Veo, Kling, Runway, or similar platforms.

Combine AI footage, stock footage, music, and sound effects into engaging videos.

Follow scripts, creative directions, and editing guidelines accurately.

Make revisions based on feedback without unnecessary resistance.

Maintain strong pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention.

Communicate regularly and meet production deadlines.

Continuously improve your editing skills and video quality.



Requirements

Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut Desktop, or similar software.

Basic experience with AI video generation tools.

Good understanding of video pacing and storytelling.

Ability to follow detailed instructions.

Willingness to learn new software, techniques, and editing styles.

Reliable internet connection and computer capable of video editing.

Strong communication skills.

Ability to work independently after receiving proper training.



The Attitude We Expect

Your attitude is just as important as your editing ability.

We are looking for someone who is:

Coachable: Accepts constructive criticism and applies feedback.

Humble: Willing to learn without being defensive or argumentative.

Reliable: Shows up on time, meets deadlines, and communicates properly.

Detail-oriented: Follows instructions instead of making unnecessary changes.

Hardworking: Takes responsibility and puts genuine effort into every video.

Adaptable: Can learn new editing styles and improve with guidance.

Respectful: Communicates professionally with management and teammates.



We provide clear instructions, examples, and feedback to help you succeed.



However, we expect you to take feedback seriously and implement improvements consistently.



We prefer a less experienced editor with an excellent attitude over a highly experienced editor who is difficult to work with.



What We DO NOT Want

Editors who argue over every correction or refuse to follow directions.

People who think they already know everything.

Applicants who are unwilling to learn or adapt.

People who rely entirely on automated AI video generation.

Editors who repeatedly ignore instructions.

Unreliable workers who disappear during working hours.



Salary, Profit Sharing & Growth

Starting salary: USD $3.50 per hour.

Working hours: 8 hours per day, 5 days per week.



Long-term, full-time remote position.



Profit sharing: Once the YouTube channel you work on becomes monetized and profitable, eligible editors will have the opportunity to earn a share of channel profits on top of their hourly salary.

Salary growth: Hourly pay may increase based on performance, skill development, and the channel's financial success.

Career growth: Opportunities to take on greater responsibilities as our YouTube media company expands.

We want our editors to grow financially as the channels grow. The more successful the channel becomes, the greater your potential earnings.



Profit-sharing terms and eligibility will be agreed upon separately.



How to Apply



Please submit:

Your video editing portfolio, preferably featuring AI-generated content.

The video editing software and AI tools you use.

Your previous editing experience.

Your computer specifications.

A short explanation of how you handle feedback and revisions.



Start your application with "READY TO LEARN" so we know you have read this job posting.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a paid editing test.



We are building a serious, long-term YouTube media company and want hardworking, respectful, and coachable people who are ready to grow with us.

title: E-commerce Performance Operator | Meta Ads & Product Testing
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We are looking for a hands-on e-commerce performance operator for a fast-moving fashion dropshipping business, with Meta Ads as the main responsibility.



This is not a role for someone who only follows instructions, reports numbers or launches campaigns prepared by somebody else. You must be comfortable researching products, preparing listings and creatives, launching tests, analyzing results, stopping losing products quickly and scaling winners profitably.



We are currently focused on the German market. Experience with fashion, dropshipping, Germany or wider European markets is a major advantage.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



Your main responsibility is managing the complete product testing and advertising process:



• Research promising fashion products for the German market



• Analyze competitors, offers, pricing, creatives and advertisements



• Add and prepare products in Shopify using Poki and Google Sheets



• Create or adapt simple advertising creatives, including images, carousels, collages and basic videos



• Write or adapt advertising copy with the help of AI tools where appropriate



• Build and launch purchase campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager



• Monitor campaign performance and spending every day



• Use data such as CPC, CTR, CPM, CPA, purchase ROAS, cost per purchase and frequency to make decisions



• Stop losing products quickly without becoming emotionally attached to them



• Identify winning products and scale them in a controlled way



• Find the budget sweet spot instead of blindly increasing spend



• Understand how product costs, shipping, payment fees, refunds and returns affect real profitability



• Communicate with suppliers about quotations, product availability, sizing and fulfillment



• Maintain clear records and report what was tested, stopped and scaled



• Provide structured Monday and Friday updates without having to be reminded



You will initially perform several parts of the e-commerce process yourself. As sales grow, customer service, order processing and other operational tasks will gradually be handed over to additional team members, allowing you to focus increasingly on product research, Meta Ads, analysis and scaling.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have real hands-on experience with Meta Ads for e-commerce or dropshipping.



You must have personally:



• Built and launched purchase campaigns in Meta Ads Manager



• Tested products and advertising creatives



• Made independent decisions about when to stop or scale campaigns



• Managed advertising budgets responsibly



• Worked with Shopify or a similar e-commerce platform



• Analyzed campaign performance using real purchase data



• Created or adapted simple advertising creatives



• Worked independently without needing instructions for every step



Fashion, apparel, German-market and European e-commerce experience are strongly preferred.



Lead generation experience alone is not enough. We are not looking for someone whose experience is mainly in real estate, coaching, home services, clinics or appointment generation.



HOW YOU SHOULD THINK



We move quickly, but we do not gamble blindly.



A winning product should be scaled, but only when the numbers support it. A losing product should be stopped before it consumes unnecessary cashflow.



You should understand that increasing the budget does not automatically increase sales. You must be able to find the right budget level, protect profitability and give every significant budget change enough time to produce reliable data.



You should be proactive, honest and comfortable taking ownership. If you see a problem, you should investigate it and propose a solution before being asked.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



Starting base rate: $15 per hour, plus performance-based bonuses.



The position starts at approximately 30 hours per week.



We will begin with a paid trial period of 10 to 14 days so that both sides can evaluate the collaboration.



When you deliver profitable results, your bonuses, hours, compensation and responsibilities can grow with the business.



There is a genuine opportunity to help build and eventually lead a small team. Growth is based on proven results, reliability and ownership.



PRACTICAL REQUIREMENTS



• Available for regular overlap with European CET working hours



• Stable internet connection and reliable computer



• Professional written and spoken English



• Comfortable using Loom or screen sharing when explaining work and results



• Available for Monday and Friday reporting



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the single word:



Rockstar



If Rockstar is not the first word of your application, your application may not be reviewed.



Then answer the following questions:



1. Which e-commerce or dropshipping stores have you personally worked on?



2. Which countries and niches did you manage?



3. What monthly advertising spend did you personally manage?



4. What purchase ROAS and cost per purchase did you achieve?



5. Explain one product you tested, including how you d ---------- whether to stop or scale it.



6. How would you test fashion products in Germany with a relatively lean starting budget?



7. Which parts can you personally handle: product research, Shopify listings, creatives, Meta Ads, supplier communication and reporting?



8. Are you comfortable starting at $5 per hour plus performance bonuses during the initial trial and proving period?



Please also include a short 2–5 minute Loom video. Introduce yourself, explain one real e-commerce campaign you personally managed and, where client confidentiality allows, show the campaign structure or results on screen. You may hide client names and sensitive information.



Generic applications, lead-generation-only experience and applications without specific e-commerce results will not be prioritized.

title: E-commerce Performance Operator | Meta Ads & Product Testing
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We are looking for a hands-on e-commerce performance operator for a fast-moving fashion dropshipping business, with Meta Ads as the main responsibility.



This is not a role for someone who only follows instructions, reports numbers or launches campaigns prepared by somebody else. You must be comfortable researching products, preparing listings and creatives, launching tests, analyzing results, stopping losing products quickly and scaling winners profitably.



We are currently focused on the German market. Experience with fashion, dropshipping, Germany or wider European markets is a major advantage.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



Your main responsibility is managing the complete product testing and advertising process:



• Research promising fashion products for the German market



• Analyze competitors, offers, pricing, creatives and advertisements



• Add and prepare products in Shopify using Poki and Google Sheets



• Create or adapt simple advertising creatives, including images, carousels, collages and basic videos



• Write or adapt advertising copy with the help of AI tools where appropriate



• Build and launch purchase campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager



• Monitor campaign performance and spending every day



• Use data such as CPC, CTR, CPM, CPA, purchase ROAS, cost per purchase and frequency to make decisions



• Stop losing products quickly without becoming emotionally attached to them



• Identify winning products and scale them in a controlled way



• Find the budget sweet spot instead of blindly increasing spend



• Understand how product costs, shipping, payment fees, refunds and returns affect real profitability



• Communicate with suppliers about quotations, product availability, sizing and fulfillment



• Maintain clear records and report what was tested, stopped and scaled



• Provide structured Monday and Friday updates without having to be reminded



You will initially perform several parts of the e-commerce process yourself. As sales grow, customer service, order processing and other operational tasks will gradually be handed over to additional team members, allowing you to focus increasingly on product research, Meta Ads, analysis and scaling.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have real hands-on experience with Meta Ads for e-commerce or dropshipping.



You must have personally:



• Built and launched purchase campaigns in Meta Ads Manager



• Tested products and advertising creatives



• Made independent decisions about when to stop or scale campaigns



• Managed advertising budgets responsibly



• Worked with Shopify or a similar e-commerce platform



• Analyzed campaign performance using real purchase data



• Created or adapted simple advertising creatives



• Worked independently without needing instructions for every step



Fashion, apparel, German-market and European e-commerce experience are strongly preferred.



Lead generation experience alone is not enough. We are not looking for someone whose experience is mainly in real estate, coaching, home services, clinics or appointment generation.



HOW YOU SHOULD THINK



We move quickly, but we do not gamble blindly.



A winning product should be scaled, but only when the numbers support it. A losing product should be stopped before it consumes unnecessary cashflow.



You should understand that increasing the budget does not automatically increase sales. You must be able to find the right budget level, protect profitability and give every significant budget change enough time to produce reliable data.



You should be proactive, honest and comfortable taking ownership. If you see a problem, you should investigate it and propose a solution before being asked.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



Starting base rate: $15 per hour, plus performance-based bonuses.



The position starts at approximately 30 hours per week.



We will begin with a paid trial period of 10 to 14 days so that both sides can evaluate the collaboration.



When you deliver profitable results, your bonuses, hours, compensation and responsibilities can grow with the business.



There is a genuine opportunity to help build and eventually lead a small team. Growth is based on proven results, reliability and ownership.



PRACTICAL REQUIREMENTS



• Available for regular overlap with European CET working hours



• Stable internet connection and reliable computer



• Professional written and spoken English



• Comfortable using Loom or screen sharing when explaining work and results



• Available for Monday and Friday reporting



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the single word:



Rockstar



If Rockstar is not the first word of your application, your application may not be reviewed.



Then answer the following questions:



1. Which e-commerce or dropshipping stores have you personally worked on?



2. Which countries and niches did you manage?



3. What monthly advertising spend did you personally manage?



4. What purchase ROAS and cost per purchase did you achieve?



5. Explain one product you tested, including how you d ---------- whether to stop or scale it.



6. How would you test fashion products in Germany with a relatively lean starting budget?



7. Which parts can you personally handle: product research, Shopify listings, creatives, Meta Ads, supplier communication and reporting?



8. Are you comfortable starting at $5 per hour plus performance bonuses during the initial trial and proving period?



Please also include a short 2–5 minute Loom video. Introduce yourself, explain one real e-commerce campaign you personally managed and, where client confidentiality allows, show the campaign structure or results on screen. You may hide client names and sensitive information.



Generic applications, lead-generation-only experience and applications without specific e-commerce results will not be prioritized.

title: HR Officer / HR Generalist (Startup, Remote then Office)
description:
Company: Vitech Solar Industries

Location: Remote at first, then on-site in Parañaque City

Salary: ₱23,000 to ₱25,000 per month (starting), depending on experience

Employment type: Full-time, with a 2-month probationary period



About Us



Vitech Solar Industries is a growing startup. We’re building our team and our systems from the ground up, and we need an HR person who can help us do it properly from the start. This is a hands-on role with a lot of room to shape how HR works in the company.



About the Role



We’re looking for an HR Officer to handle our day-to-day HR work, from recruitment to employee records to making sure we follow Philippine labor laws. You’ll work directly with management and be the go-to person for anything people-related.



What You’ll Do

- Manage the full hiring process: write job posts, source and screen candidates, schedule interviews, send offers, and run onboarding

- Prepare and maintain 201 files, employment contracts, and company policies

- Track attendance, leaves, and schedules, and help prepare payroll inputs

- Keep records and registrations for SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, and BIR up to date, and make sure contributions are filed on time

- Make sure the company follows DOLE and other labor requirements

- Handle employee concerns, memos, and basic disciplinary documentation properly

- Answer employee questions about benefits, leaves, and company policies

- Help set up HR policies and processes as the company grows



What We’re Looking For



- Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resource Management, Business Administration, or a related field

- At least 1 to 2 years of HR experience (generalist or recruitment); fresh graduates with strong HR internship experience are welcome to apply

- Working knowledge of Philippine labor laws, compliance, and government-mandated benefits

- Good communication and organizational skills, and able to keep information confidential

- Comfortable in a fast-paced startup where you’ll wear many hats and build processes from scratch

- Comfortable with Google Workspace or MS Office, and able to work independently from home

- Willing to transition to on-site work in Parañaque City once our office is ready



What We Offer



- Competitive starting starting salary of ₱23,000 to ₱25,000

- Work-from-home setup at the start, moving to our Parañaque office later

-  2-month probationary period, with regularization based on performance

-  Real growth opportunities as the startup scales



How to Apply



Send your resume and a short note about your HR experience with the subject line “HR Officer Application – FULL NAME”.

Are you experienced with **CJ Dropshipping, dropshipping supply chain operations, and supplier quotations**? Are you looking for your next challenge in a fast-growing eCommerce business with real room for career growth? Then you've found the right opportunity!



## 🚀 About Us



- 4-year-old eCommerce dropshipping business operating across multiple niches

- Shopify-based business generating multiple 6-figure monthly revenue

- Currently processing **500 orders per day**, primarily shipping to the USA

- A team of highly skilled A-Players in their respective fields



## 📦 About the Position



We are looking for someone who can **join our team as soon as possible** and help us manage our growing supply chain operations.



Our most urgent priority is finding someone with **hands-on experience working directly within the CJ Dropshipping platform**, particularly when it comes to handling and processing new order quotations.

- Negotiating with suppliers to secure the best possible terms

title: B2B Partnerships & Prospecting Specialist (Football/Soccer)
description:
Job Title: B2B Partnerships & Prospecting Specialist (Football/Soccer) – Remote, Full-Time



Compensation: 25,000 PHP base salary + monthly performance bonuses. Strong performers realistically earn 35,000 to 40,000+ PHP / month based on booked, qualified partner calls and active referrals.



ABOUT US

We are an established sports placement and career development platform run by active professional athletes and industry specialists. We assist top talent in securing trials, contracts, and roster spots internationally through an extensive global network of club decision-makers, scouts, and sporting directors across [Redacted] countries.



THE ROLE

We are looking for a sharp, proactive B2B Partnerships Specialist to help build, nurture, and scale our international referral network. Our target partners include independent 1-on-1 performance trainers, private high-performance academies, elite showcase operators, and regional talent media pages.

You will own top-of-funnel operations: researching target partners, executing structured multi-channel outreach, qualifying prospective partners, and booking high-intent alignment calls directly onto executive calendar schedules. You will also assist with onboarding newly signed partners and keeping our active partner network engaged ahead of key operational registration/transfer windows.

(Note: You will be building B2B relationships directly with coaches, trainers, and academy directors—you do not sell directly to individual athletes or run high-ticket consumer sales calls).



WHAT YOU’LL DO

* Research & Prospecting: Identify, screen, and score qualified target partners (private trainers, private academies, showcase operators, talent pages) across our key target regions.

* Outreach & Engagement: Build clean target databases and execute highly personalized, professional outreach campaigns via
, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp (preparing priority accounts for executive social media engagement).

* Qualification & Booking: Screen incoming partner inquiries, confirm alignment criteria, and schedule 1-on-1 partnership calls directly onto executive calendars.

* Partner Support & Onboarding: Assist newly signed partners during onboarding by delivering custom referral links, tracking setups, and concise 1-page partnership briefs.

* Transfer Window Cadence: Maintain consistent, structured communication and regular follow-ups with existing network partners ahead of primary global player registration/transfer windows (e.g., January & July) to ensure ongoing alignment.

* Pipeline & Data Management: Maintain meticulous CRM hygiene in GoHighLevel (GHL) and prepare monthly partner activity and bonus performance/payout reports.



WHAT WE NEED

* Language & Communication: Native-level written and spoken English with a clear, professional, and articulate tone suitable for communicating directly with international directors and head coaches.

* B2B Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in B2B outreach, lead generation, or appointment setting (must demonstrate the ability to write authentic, highly custom, non-spammy messages).

* Organizational Discipline: Exceptional CRM tracking, lead documentation, and calendar schedule management—ensuring prompt follow-ups and zero dropped leads.

* Self-Driven Mindset: Proactive problem solver who takes initiative to locate and evaluate high-caliber prospects rather than strictly relying on a fixed script.



NICE TO HAVE

Solid understanding of competitive football (soccer) development pathways and leagues across international markets.

Direct hands-on experience navigating GoHighLevel (GHL) workflows, pipelines, and contact management.

title: Facebook Media Buyer
description:
Hello. Currently, I am looking to hire a
 media buyer who understands how the ad platform works.



Things you must understand:

- We hate Advantage Plus creative features. Turn them off at all costs.

- You must understand how big caps work, how to navigate the Meta platform, and work with us to get our campaigns launched and ready.



I'm looking for someone to work with long term, but want to start you off with some gig work in terms of launching our ads. 



Here's the situation we are currently in: our old ad account had gotten banned, and we need to relaunch all of our old ads. (It's a lot)



You will be guided on the way you want to do it. You will be provided with a creative tracker, and the bulk majority of our ads are already launched for you. 



You will need to finish setting up our USA campaign and also set up a worldwide campaign for us. 



You are going to take it slow with the initial launches, meaning you will launch three ad sets at a time. Wait for the ads to get scheduled/approved, and then launch the next ones. 



If an ad gets rejected, you immediately replace it with an image of a puppy. Let that ad get approved, and then turn it off. 



We need to maintain the integrity of our ad account, especially with the current end wave going on. If you're up for a media buying challenge and you want to potentially work with us long term, drop your resume, and I'll be in touch with you to get you going, possibly even today.

title: Remote Sales Representative / Client Coordinator (Fluent in English) - (US Hours) (MALE only)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



(Please submit your resume/CV and a 60-second English voice recording.)



We are hiring a Client Advisors / Crisis Response Coordinators to join our remote team. We are currently hiring for Shift A. The shift schedule is based on Manila Time / Philippine Time (PHT).



As part of your application, please send a 60-second English voice recording introducing yourself, explaining why you are a strong fit for this role, and briefly summarizing your phone-based sales, client support, or customer service experience.



Important Requirement:

- This is a full-time, dedicated role. We are looking for candidates who can fully commit to their assigned shift.

- This role is not suitable as a second job, side job, or additional freelance role. Because response time, reliability, and emotional availability are critical in this position, candidates must not be working another job that conflicts with their schedule, focus, or performance.



About the Role

- This role includes a sales component, but it is not an aggressive sales role.

- You will not be cold-calling random prospects or pushing products.

- Your job is to respond quickly to inbound inquiries, calm the client when needed, understand the urgency of the case, explain how the service works, recommend the right service package, and guide the client through agreement, payment, onboarding, and handoff to our operations team.

- We are looking for candidates with a mature, steady, and confident phone presence. The right person should sound calm under pressure, communicate clearly with US-based clients, and handle sensitive conversations professionally.



What You'll Do

- Respond to inbound leads through phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, and messaging platforms within minutes.

-Conduct first consultations by listening to the client's situation, assessing urgency, and recommending the most suitable service package.

- Explain the services, pricing, onboarding steps, contracts, and expectations clearly.

- Guide clients through the agreement, payment, and onboarding process.

-Coordinate with the operations team after the client signs up to ensure a smooth case handoff.

- Follow up with clients at key milestones, including after 24 hours, weekly updates, and service completion.

- Maintain accurate records in our dashboard, including lead status, call notes, messages, contracts, and follow-up tasks.

- Collect client feedback and reviews after successful service completion.

- Work reliably during your assigned shift to ensure fast response coverage.

- What We're Looking For

- At least 2 years of phone-based sales, customer service, client consultation, call center, or account support experience.

- Clear spoken English and the ability to communicate confidently with US-based clients.

- Calm, mature, and professional phone manner.

- Strong empathy and emotional control when speaking with distressed clients.

- Ability to guide a conversation without sounding pushy or aggressive.

- Experience handling objections, pricing conversations, and follow-ups.

- Strong reliability. Late starts, missed shifts, and no-shows directly affect client response times.

- Ability to fully commit to this role as your primary work commitment.

- Fast and stable internet connection.

- Quiet workspace suitable for professional calls.

- Own computer, headset, and microphone.

- Comfortable using CRM, dashboard, messaging, and calling tools.



Nice to Have

- Experience in legal services, insurance, cybersecurity, financial services, healthcare support, emergency support, trust and safety, or crisis-related customer service.

- Previous experience working with US-based clients.

- Inbound sales, client advisory, retention, or customer success background.

- Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Notion, GoHighLevel, Slack, WhatsApp Business, Aircall, RingCentral, Zendesk, or similar platforms.

- Experience in sensitive client conversations where confidentiality, trust, and clear communication are important. 



Available Shift Schedules

- We are currently hiring for the following shift A (Manila Time / PHT):



Shift A: 8:00 PM – 4:00 AM (PHT)



Candidates must be consistently available during the full assigned shift.



Compensation & Growth

Base salary: $800/month

Commission: 3%–5% on closed deals, depending on monthly performance and collected revenue.

Additional performance incentives may include client review bonuses and other performance-based rewards.

Top performers may be promoted to Senior Client Advisor / Team Lead, with a base salary increase and additional training responsibilities.

Employee Benefits

Monthly base salary + tiered commission.

$10 bonus per verified customer review.

$300 retention bonus every 3 months of tenure.

13th month pay: 1× base salary, paid by December 20, soft-conditional on hitting average commission performance.

7 days paid annual leave per year.

3 days paid sick leave per year (no doctor's note required).

2× pay for work on Philippine regular public holidays.

Guaranteed weekly rest day

Hiring Process

Application review.

Resume/CV and voice recording review.

Written screening assessment.

Live interview with scenario-based questions.

Reference/profile check.

Offer, NDA, agreement, and onboarding.



How to Apply: Please submit your resume/CV and a 60-second English voice recording.



Your recording should include:

- A brief introduction of yourself.

- Why you believe you are a strong fit for this role.

- A short summary of your phone-based sales, customer service, call center, client consultation, or account support experience.

- Confirmation that you can fully commit to the shift you apply for and that this will be your primary full-time job.

Google VEO 3 

Higgsfield 

Google Gemini 

AI UGC avatar tools 

AI image generators

Receive a creative brief (concept, angle, script) and independently produce: 

3–10 video variations 

5–20 static image variations 

Rapid iterations based on feedback and performance data 

Add engaging on-screen text, captions, VFX, and sound design. 

Incorporate our pre-existing footage + newly generated AI elements. 

Help conceptualize ideas that improve CTR, hook rate, thumbstop ratio, and ROAS. 

Deliver creatives in a Meta-native format (short form, mobile-first, bold text, fast pacing). 



Required Skills + Experience (please do not apply if you don't meet the criteria):



Direct-Response Creative Editing 

Knowledge of high-performing Meta ads formats 

Strong understanding of: Hooks, Pacing, Retention strategy, CTA placement AI Video & Image Generation (Advanced) 

Strong prompting abilities

Workflow experience (storyboarding, prompt crafting, refining, upscaling) 

Technical Editing Software Skills 

Adobe Premiere Pro 

CapCut Desktop 

DaVinci Resolve

Final Cut Pro 

Photoshop, Canva, or Figma for static ads 

Ability to sync voiceovers and maintain pacing 

Paid Social Creative Knowledge 

Understanding of creative testing 

Ability to interpret creative performance metrics like: Hook rate, Thumbstop percentage, CTR, Watch-time dropoff 

Work Speed

title: Shopify Developer — CRO & AOV Test Implementation
description:
We’re looking for a Shopify developer who can turn our conversion rate optimization (CRO) and average order value (AOV) ideas into reliable, ready-to-launch experiments.



We own the ideas, hypotheses, and priorities. You own the technical execution. Your role is to understand each test brief, flag technical limitations, build the experience, and make sure it works properly across devices.



What you’ll do



- Implement CRO and AOV tests across product pages, landing pages, collection pages, and the cart.

- Build and modify Shopify sections, templates, and reusable components.

- Execute ideas such as bundles, quantity breaks, upsells, cross-sells, free-shipping progress bars, sticky add-to-cart buttons, and offer messaging.

- Set up test variants in our testing platform and verify that targeting and tracking work correctly.

- Integrate and customize apps where needed, recommending custom development when it’s the better fit.

- QA each test across mobile and desktop, checking product variants, discounts, cart behavior, and key purchase journeys.

- Protect site speed and existing functionality when shipping changes.

- Roll out winning tests, remove losing variants, and keep the codebase organized.



What we’re looking for



- AI first (utilizing all the latest ai tools to help with your output)

- Strong hands-on Shopify development experience.

- Confidence with Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Shopify themes, and Online Store 2.0.

- Experience implementing ecommerce experiments or conversion-focused storefront changes.

- Familiarity with A/B testing tools, analytics events, and tracking validation.

- Strong mobile implementation skills and attention to visual detail.

- An understanding of Shopify’s checkout, discount, and app limitations.

- Clear communication, realistic delivery estimates, and dependable follow-through.



How we’ll work



You’ll receive a test brief outlining the idea, intended customer experience, and success metric. You’ll clarify implementation details, estimate the work, build the test, and provide a preview for review before launch.



You should be comfortable working from a clear brief without always needing a pixel-perfect design. We expect you to flag edge cases and suggest practical implementation improvements while staying focused on the test.



What success looks like



- Tests move from brief to launch quickly and reliably.

- Implementations match the intended customer experience.

- Tracking is validated before launch.

- Changes work smoothly on mobile and desktop.

- Bugs, performance regressions, and unnecessary complexity are kept to a minimum.



You’ll be measured on execution quality, delivery speed, and reliability—not whether every hypothesis wins.



To apply, please fill-in this application form: 



Please fill-in the "Additional Information" section:



- Two or three relevant Shopify projects and what you personally built.

- An example of a CRO or AOV experiment you implemented.

- Your availability

title: Finance Manager (Daily Reporting)
description:
Full time, 40 hours a week, spread across 7 days. Remote, based in the Philippines. Reports to the CEO.



We are a 24/7 business. That is why the week is 7 days and not 5. The hours are normal, the rhythm is not.

We are a two entity, two market, inventory heavy DTC beauty business running on Shopify and Amazon with China direct and 3PL fulfilment. Revenue is not our problem. Visibility is.



We need a qualified accountant who turns a messy, cross border operation into a small set of numbers we can look at every single day and trust. Not a month end role. Not a board deck role. A daily discipline role.



The rhythm is the point: a report lands every morning, seven days a week, including weekends and holidays. We spend money on ads every day, so we need to see profit and cash every day. Weekends are when problems hide.

The Philippines time zone is a deliberate advantage here. You work your morning, the previous European day has just closed, and your pack is in Slack before Amsterdam opens.



You will work alongside our existing external accounting partners (a US accounting firm, Dutch bookkeepers and a cross border accountant) rather than replacing them. They handle statutory and compliance. You own management reporting.



The daily rhythm

Every day, 7 days a week, delivered by 13:00 PHT (around 07:00 CET):

• Cash position across all bank accounts and both entities

• Yesterday’s revenue, gross profit and ad spend by market and channel

• Blended MER and contribution margin after ad spend

• Refunds, chargebacks and payment provider reserve movements

• Any red flag, called out in one line at the top

Weekend versions can be a lighter, largely templated snapshot, but they land.

Every Monday:

• Full management P&L for the prior week

• Contribution margin by SKU, channel and market

• Inventory position and stock cover in weeks

• Rolling 13 week cash flow forecast, updated

• KPI pack for the founding team

Every month:

• Consolidated cross border P&L (NL and US) and balance sheet review

• Variance against plan, with commentary on the why

• Reconciliation sign off across Shopify, Amazon, payment providers, 3PL and the ledger

What You’ll Own Beyond the Reporting

• Cash forecasting: the rolling 13 week forecast, including inventory and purchase order cash planning against production lead times

• Unit economics: true landed COGS per SKU (freight, duty, fulfilment), and contribution margin by SKU, channel, market and cohort

• Channel P&Ls: Shopify DACH, Shopify US, Amazon US, comparable and reconciled

• Payment risk monitoring: reserves, rolling reserves and chargeback exposure

• FX exposure across EUR, USD and PHP

• Invoice verification: supplier and 3PL invoices checked against contracted terms

• Automation: templates, defined metrics, connected data sources. If the daily pack takes two hours by month three, something is wrong



What We’re Looking For

• Philippine CPA, or an equivalent qualification with a strong practical track record

• 4+ years in accounting or finance, including hands on management reporting

title: DeFi Partnerships Manager: Run the Reps, Book the Calls, Earn Uncapped Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

description:

An Australian electrical, air conditioning and maintenance business needs a part-time Simpro and admin VA to keep the back office running on the days the current office admin isn’t in, and gradually take over the Simpro workload so she can focus on bookkeeping. The core of the role is phones,
, job and quote creation, scheduling, purchase orders and invoice preparation in Simpro, plus verifying the team’s hours against what is being charged to customers. Capability to cover team and supplier payments in Xero down the track is also wanted, in case the business grows into two VAs. A website refresh is a nice-to-have.



The key challenge is consistency in a business that currently has none. The right person will bring structure rather than wait for it, push the owners for answers when needed, and treat the business like their own. The owners want someone who says “our business” and sees this as their dream role.



Success looks like no missed calls or
s on the office admin’s days off, Simpro being used properly (and better than it is today), accurate invoices that match actual hours worked, and a VA who has outgrown the four hours and is ready to move to full-time.

Check and respond to
s in the admin inbox, reading the full
 trail before replying

s

Your job is to turn that research into a plan.



The role

You build the monthly A/B testing roadmap for each of our clients. It’s a clear plan of what we’re testing over the next 30 days, across every key area of the store: homepage, product page, cart and checkout. You keep that plan updated as results come in, and you show new prospects what their first month with us would look like.



What you’ll do



Research top ecommerce brands and each client’s competitors

Read Reddit to learn how customers actually talk

Build customer profiles based on awareness levels and market sophistication

Turn all of that into a testing roadmap for each client every month

Update each roadmap through the month, changing course based on what the tests teach us

Write proposals for prospects, laying out a roadmap of tests for their first month at Beyond the Fold

Write Figma briefs for the tests on each roadmap

Write monthly client reports covering last month’s performance and learnings

Talk with clients on Slack



What you need



Real CRO experience with Shopify brands, with tests you’ve run and what happened

Strong Shopify knowledge

Experience with Intelligems

Comfortable in Figma, and able to write a design brief a designer can follow without asking questions

A high level of written English. Our clients are US and UK founders.



Hours and pay



Full-time, long-term

Normal daytime hours. I’m based in Bali, which is on the same time zone as the Philippines.

You need to check Slack throughout the day and reply to clients and the team. Because our clients are in the US and UK, this sometimes runs into the evening, but rarely past 7 to 9pm.

:

**Dribbin & Brown Criminal Lawyers | Australian Law Firm | Remote – Philippines**



Dribbin & Brown Criminal Lawyers is an established criminal law firm based in Australia. We are expanding our dedicated remote team in the Philippines and are seeking an experienced Customer Service / Receptionist to join us on a full-time, long-term basis.



Having previously worked with external call centre providers, we have transitioned to an in-house remote team model. Our Philippine team currently consists of four members who work closely with our Australian legal and administrative staff.



This position offers an opportunity to become part of the firm's ongoing operations and contribute to the delivery of professional, client-focused legal services.



Position Details



- Engagement: Full-time subcontractor

- Work arrangement: Fully remote, Philippines

- Initial hourly rate: ₱288 per hour

- Compensation potential: Earnings of ₱75,000 per month or more may be achievable through increased rates and commissions, subject to performance and the applicable compensation arrangements.



The initial rate applies during the training and assessment period. Following this period, compensation may be reviewed based on demonstrated competency, performance, reliability, and overall suitability for the role.



We value long-term team members and recognize strong performance through opportunities for increased compensation and commissions.



WORK SCHEDULE:

title: AI Solutions Engineer – Software, Systems & AI Automation
description:
JOB TITLE: AI Solutions Engineer – Software, Systems & AI Automation

COMPANY: Ashlex LLC

LOCATION: Philippines (Remote)

TYPE: Part-time initially, with long-term / full-time potential

EXPERIENCE: Strong mid-level technical generalist or above

COMPENSATION: Negotiable, based on experience and demonstrated ability



ABOUT ASHLEX



Ashlex is a US-based company providing technology consulting, custom software development, hosting, business management, and business process outsourcing (BPO) services. We develop applications and internal tools, integrate commercial software, maintain infrastructure, and support clients in different industries.



We actively use AI tools including Codex, ChatGPT, and other LLMs to help us develop solutions faster and work more effectively.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're looking for a technically strong, resourceful, creative person who knows how to use AI to solve real business and technology problems.



This is NOT an entry-level role, and we're NOT looking for someone whose only technical skill is prompting AI to generate code. A solid, hands-on technical background is essential. You should understand programming, Linux, servers, databases, APIs, networking fundamentals, troubleshooting, and how applications actually work.



You don't have to know every tool or language. You must be able to understand and verify AI-generated work, identify mistakes, investigate unfamiliar problems, make sensible technical decisions, and finish assignments.



The work is varied. One day you might build an application. The next you might troubleshoot a Linux server, plan a technical project, design a dashboard, connect APIs, automate a workflow, research a new product, or improve an existing business system.



You will work closely with our Founder and CEO. Over time, a successful candidate may grow into broader technical leadership. We are looking for a builder and problem solver first, not someone seeking an executive title immediately.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



AI, automation and general problem solving

- Use Codex, ChatGPT, and other approved AI tools productively and responsibly.

- Research, prototype, evaluate, and implement technical solutions.

- Create integrations, scripts, automations, and internal tools.

- Identify practical ways AI can improve development and operations.

- Check AI output for accuracy, security, reliability, and maintainability.



Software development

- Build and maintain custom web applications and business systems.

- Work with existing codebases as well as modern technologies.

- Develop APIs, database integrations, and web interfaces.

- Troubleshoot, test, document, and improve software.

- Use Git, Docker, and structured development workflows.



Systems administration and troubleshooting

- Assist with Linux server and hosting administration.

- Diagnose application, web server, network, database, and deployment issues.

- Help with updates, configurations, backups, monitoring, and reliability improvements.

- Collaborate with our existing systems administrator.

- Follow approved procedures for production and security-sensitive changes.



Design and user experience

- Create or improve website layouts, dashboards, forms, and application interfaces.

- Build responsive, usable interfaces and prototypes.

- Work with designers and WordPress developers when specialized help is needed.

- Use good visual judgment and AI-assisted creative tools appropriately.



Planning and delivery

- Turn business needs into implementation plans and manageable tasks.

- Research options, estimate effort, and identify dependencies and risks.

- Communicate progress and raise blockers early.

- Coordinate handoffs with developers, operations, and independent QA.

- Take assignments through testing, documentation, and completion.



REQUIRED

- Strong hands-on technical experience with software development and troubleshooting.

- Practical understanding of web applications, APIs, SQL databases, and server fundamentals.

- Linux and general system administration familiarity.

- Practical experience using AI tools for technical work, with the judgment to check their output.

- Ability to learn unfamiliar codebases and technologies.

- Strong independent problem solving, organization, and follow-through.

- Clear written English and some overlap with New York business hours.



USEFUL BUT NOT REQUIRED

- JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Perl, or other languages.

- PostgreSQL/MySQL, Docker, Git, cloud hosting, and Linux administration.

- WordPress, n8n, CRM/helpdesk systems, and workflow automation.

- UI/UX tools such as Figma and graphic design experience.

- LLM APIs, AI agents, integrations, and technical project planning.



WHO WILL DO WELL HERE



You are curious, technically grounded, comfortable with variety, and willing to learn. You don't give up just because a problem is new. You ask good questions, use AI thoughtfully, explain your decisions, and finish what you start. You care about a tested, working result—not simply producing code or reports.



WORKING WITH US



This role begins with a paid part-time trial. Long-term hours and compensation will depend on results, business needs, and mutual fit. We work on New York time and require some schedule overlap, but can be flexible.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

1. A short introduction describing your technical experience.

2. Two or three projects you personally contributed to, explaining your actual role.

3. Which AI tools you use and how you verify their output.

4. An example of a difficult technical problem you solved independently.

5. Your hands-on experience with Linux, systems administration, databases, and software development.

6. Your expected hourly rate, weekly availability, and New York time overlap.



Please don't send a generic AI-generated cover letter. We actively encourage using AI, but want to understand your own experience and judgment.



Shortlisted candidates may complete a paid assessment involving AI-assisted development, troubleshooting, planning, and communication.



If you enjoy solving practical problems, building useful technology, and using AI to accomplish more, we'd like to hear from you.





**IMPORTANT – APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS**



**PLEASE APPLY ONLY THROUGH THIS JOB POSTING.**



Do not contact me through personal social media, private messaging,
, or any other personal accounts.



**Anyone who attempts to bypass the application process by contacting me directly through personal channels will be automatically disqualified, and their application will not be reviewed.**



Please respect this requirement and follow the application instructions. Thank you.

title: AI Video Automation Builder: Turn Ad Scripts Into Finished Videos Automatically
description:
We're a US direct-to-consumer supplement brand with every ad made by AI. Right now editors do each step by hand. We want someone to build a system that takes an approved script and outputs a finished, launch-ready video ad with minimal human touch.



**What you'll build**

A pipeline, owned by us and living in our repo, that goes from script to finished ad:

- **Breakdown:** splits the script into scenes and shots, and writes the prompts for each one

- **Visuals:** generates consistent characters and scenes through APIs (Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Nano Banana, Magnific or similar)

- **Voice and music:** voiceover and lip-sync through ElevenLabs, and songs for music ads through Suno

- **Edit:** assembles the cut automatically with captions, sound effects, product shots and the offer card (FFmpeg, Remotion or similar)

- **Delivery:** outputs 9:16 and 4:5 versions straight to a Google Drive folder, ready to launch

- **Fixes:** handles revisions by re-running only the shots that changed



The formats it needs to handle are drama ads (1 to 4 minute AI story ads with recurring characters), song ads made with Suno, and doctor or talking-head explainers.



**You're a fit if you**

- Have already built an automated or agent-driven video pipeline (show us what it outputs)

- Write code: Python or Node, API integrations, and agent tools like Claude Code

- Understand what makes a direct-response ad work, not just how to render one, and can judge your own output

- Document what you build so it keeps running without you



**Deal**

A project fee to build the first working version, then a monthly retainer to run and improve it. Bonus when ads from the pipeline become top spenders. Everything you build, including code, prompts and workflows, belongs to us and lives in our accounts. 



**How to apply**

1. Show us a pipeline you've built: a screen recording or repo walkthrough, plus 2 to 3 videos it produced.

2. In a few lines, tell us how you'd keep a character looking the same across 20 shots.

3. Paid test: we give you one of our scripts, and you show it running through your setup to a finished ad in 24 hours.



Applications without a working example won't be reviewed.

title: Freelance Project Manager

Services and Deliverables:







Client and Account Understanding



Act as the primary point of coordination for assigned client accounts and projects.

Build and maintain a working understanding of each client's business, objectives, priorities, brand, contracted scope, ongoing projects and service requirements.

Receive, review and analyze client requests before work is assigned, checking each one against the contracted scope, the client's objectives and current account priorities.

Identify incomplete briefs, missing information, conflicting instructions, unrealistic requirements, dependencies and risks before work begins, and resolve them before tasks are handed to specialists.

Obtain the clarification and information needed from clients and internal stakeholders.

Translate client requests and strategic requirements into clear, complete and actionable tasks and project briefs.

Identify bottlenecks, resource constraints, risks, scope issues and delays before they materially affect delivery.

Provide specialists with the requirements, information and resources needed to progress assigned work.





Quality Control and Review



Review deliverables before client submission for completeness, accuracy, quality, brand consistency, adherence to the brief and alignment with client objectives.

Coordinate projects across digital marketing, websites, SEO, branding, graphic design, content, paid advertising,
 marketing and video production, and identify quality issues in each.

Return work for correction where a deliverable does not meet the brief or the required standard, with specific and actionable notes.

Coordinate revisions and ensure client feedback is communicated, tracked and implemented correctly.





Performance Tracking, KPIs and Reporting



Work with each client to establish relevant, measurable KPIs for their account and active projects, grounded in the client's actual business objectives.

Track KPI performance on an ongoing basis and maintain a current, accurate record of results against target.

Produce and deliver KPI and performance reports to clients on the agreed cadence, translating results into what happened, why, and what it means for the account.

Flag KPI underperformance, plateaus or notable wins proactively rather than waiting for the scheduled report.





Client Communication and Expectation Management



Communicate project updates, questions, recommendations, delays, risks and required decisions to clients promptly and professionally.

Lead or attend client meetings, planning sessions, project reviews and presentations relevant to assigned accounts.

Produce and maintain meeting agendas, notes, action items, follow-ups and project documentation.

Manage client expectations on timelines, deliverables, revisions, priorities and scope.

Identify potentially out-of-scope requests and refer them to the Company before resources are committed.

Analyze client objectives and KPI performance and recommend alternative or improved approaches where appropriate.





Financial and Resource Oversight



Monitor project budgets, allocated client hours, service allocations and resource utilization.

Identify potential overages, underutilization and resource issues and report them.





Internal Reporting and Documentation



Report material client concerns, delivery risks, delays and operational problems to the Company.

Maintain accurate and current project records, task statuses, documentation and communications.

Produce process documentation and recommend improvements to workflows, communication, systems and quality-control procedures.





Systems, Tools and Compliance

Use AI-assisted tools where appropriate and verify material outputs independently before relying on or submitting them.

Protect confidential client, Company, project and account information.

Record service time in the Company's portal for billing, project allocation and verification of approved additional services.





Service Standards



Assigned projects are delivered on or before the agreed date at a rate of 95 percent or higher.

Briefs issued to specialists are complete enough to be worked from without a follow-up conversation.

Client communication is answered within the agreed response time, and every meeting produces a written recap with owners and dates.
