We're looking for a highly organised logistics and quality assurance coordinator with exceptional attention to detail, strong communication skills and the ability to take ownership of tasks from start to finish.



Your main responsibility will be making sure our projects are properly prepared, materials arrive correctly and on time, and all required QA documentation is completed, checked and filed.



We need someone who is proactive, works efficiently and identifies problems before they cause delays or additional costs.



This is not simply an administrative role. We want someone who takes responsibility for keeping things organised, following up outstanding items and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Key responsibilities



Logistics and material coordination



• Coordinate material orders, supplier deliveries, freight and equipment movements across our Australian projects.



• Review purchase orders, drawings, specifications and material lists to confirm the correct items and quantities have been ordered.



• Track supplier manufacturing progress, dispatch dates, delivery schedules and outstanding components.



• Coordinate with suppliers and freight providers to confirm packing lists, shipment details, dimensions, weights and delivery requirements.



• Arrange freight consolidation where materials from multiple suppliers need to be combined into a single delivery.



• Coordinate receiving inspections with suppliers and logistics partners to verify materials against approved lists before dispatch.



• Obtain packing photos, delivery records and supporting documentation to confirm materials are complete and correctly identified.



• Identify shortages, incorrect components, damaged materials and delivery discrepancies. Follow through until resolved.



• Coordinate movement of tools, lifting equipment and other company assets between projects.



• Confirm site delivery requirements, including access, unloading equipment, delivery contacts and any restrictions.



• Maintain accurate records of material orders, deliveries, equipment movements and outstanding items.



Quality assurance and document control



• Maintain accurate QA records for projects from initial procurement through to completion.



• Prepare, review and track inspection and test plans (ITPs), QA checklists, material certificates and supporting documentation.



• Check documentation for completeness, consistency and correct project details before submitting it for technical approval.



• Review inspection photographs, site records and supporting evidence to confirm that required documentation has been provided.



• Identify missing signatures, incomplete inspection records, incorrect document revisions and conflicting information.



• Coordinate with suppliers, engineers, site supervisors and subcontractors to obtain outstanding QA documentation.



• Maintain defect registers, nonconformance records and rectification action lists.



• Track outstanding defects and corrective actions until the responsible person confirms completion.



• Ensure current approved drawings, procedures and specifications are available to the relevant team members.



• Coordinate completion reports, inspection reports, warranty documentation and final handover packages.



• Maintain organised project folders and document registers so records can be located easily.



Technical and engineering approvals remain the responsibility of the appropriate qualified personnel. Your role is to make sure the information is complete, accurate and ready for review.



Project preparation and operational support



• Review upcoming projects and identify outstanding requirements before mobilisation.



• Confirm required materials, equipment, tools and documentation are ready before work is scheduled to begin.



• Coordinate site access requirements, inductions, licences, certificates and other necessary approvals.



• Work with our operations team to confirm site readiness and any outstanding client responsibilities.



• Track installation schedules, supplier commitments and delivery deadlines.



• Identify potential delays early and communicate them clearly to the relevant team members.



• Follow up with site supervisors to obtain daily records, photographs, completed checklists and outstanding QA evidence.



• Keep project status, outstanding actions and key dates updated in our management systems.



• Support the operations and accounts teams by identifying outstanding documentation or approvals that may delay project milestones and payments.



• Ensure projects have a clear record of outstanding items and responsibilities through to final completion.



Communication and attention to detail



Strong communication is essential. You'll be dealing with our Australian team, suppliers, transport companies, engineers and clients.



We expect someone who can communicate clearly, ask precise questions and follow through without constant reminders.



• Read relevant
s, drawings and supporting documents before responding.



• Understand the actual issue before asking questions or requesting further information.



• Write clear, natural and professional
s.



• Be confident making phone calls when they will resolve an issue faster than
.



• Confirm important details rather than making assumptions.



• Check job numbers, drawings, quantities, specifications, delivery addresses and attachments before sending.



• Keep the right people informed when something changes or requires attention.



• Take ownership of outstanding tasks until they are resolved or properly handed over.



We need someone who can produce accurate work with minimal correction. Being busy is not the same as making progress. We value people who finish what they start.



Improve how we work



We're looking for someone who can improve our logistics and QA processes, not just follow existing procedures.



This includes helping us build and maintain reliable checklists, material registers, QA templates and project tracking systems.



You should be comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools to review documents, organise information, prepare correspondence and reduce repetitive administration.



You must be able to check AI generated information against the original documents and recognise when something requires further review.



We want someone who actively identifies opportunities to reduce errors, avoid unnecessary costs and make our operations more efficient.



What we're looking for



• Experience in logistics coordination, construction administration, quality assurance, document control, procurement or a similar role.



• Experience working with construction, engineering, manufacturing or industrial projects is highly desirable.



• Exceptional attention to detail and consistent accuracy.



• Excellent written and spoken English. You must be articulate, professional and confident communicating with Australian clients and suppliers.

• Confidence using ChatGPT, AI tools and other technology to improve productivity.



• Experience with Pipedrive, ServiceM8, Google Workspace or similar systems would be an advantage.



• Initiative, accountability and consistent follow through.



You should not need repeated reminders to chase suppliers, update records, follow up outstanding documents or complete assigned tasks.



About the role



This is a remote position working with our Australian team during agreed Australian business hours.



We will provide training on our products, systems and internal processes. However, you must already have strong organisational skills, attention to detail and professional communication abilities.



You will work closely with our operations, engineering, procurement and project management teams.



Performance will be measured by:

• Completeness and accuracy of QA documentation.



• Timely identification and resolution of outstanding issues.



• Reliable project updates and follow through.



• Reduction in avoidable delays, missing materials and documentation errors.



• Clear, responsive communication with the team, suppliers and clients.



There is an opportunity to grow into a broader operations or quality management role as you develop your understanding of the business.

In your video, briefly explain:

• One practical example of how you have used AI or automation to improve your work.



Send your CV as an attachment in the same WhatsApp chat. Include your expected monthly salary in USD, earliest start date and availability during Australian business hours.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a practical exercise covering material reconciliation, QA document checking, attention to detail and client communication.



Applications without a video sent directly in WhatsApp will not be considered.

title: AutoCAD Electrical Drafter — LV Switchboard & Single Line Diagrams (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT US



We are a sheet-metal fabrication and modular building company based in Perth, Western Australia. We design and build prefabricated equipment rooms - complete modular buildings fitted out with switchboards, UPS and battery systems, HVAC, lighting and cabling - which are built in our workshop and delivered to site.



THE ROLE



We have a large, repeating program of electrical drafting work and we need one dedicated drafter to own it. You will work from approved typical designs and site-specific input data to produce the issued electrical drawing pack for each building. This is ongoing work, not a one-off project - we have roughly 40 buildings to deliver over the next two to three years, at 10-15 drawings per building.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DRAWING, EVERY WEEK



- Main switchboard and distribution board single line diagrams - complete with asset tags, ratings, IP and form of separation, fault levels, busbar and circuit breaker schedules

- Automatic and manual supply changeover schematics

- UPS and battery system single lines, bypass arrangements and connection details

- Distribution board schedules and lighting control schematics

- Label schedules and switchboard layout/elevation sheets

- Cable schedule cross-referencing between sheets

- Revision control - clouding, revision triangles, title block maintenance, and issuing clean PDF sets for transmittal



WHAT YOU ARE NOT DOING



You are not the design engineer. Max demand calculations, fault level and protection coordination are done by our engineering team and given to you as inputs. Your job is to turn approved design intent into accurate, consistent, issue-ready drawings.



ESSENTIAL



- Strong AutoCAD 2D - you will be working in our native .dwg files, our title block, our layers and our standards

- AutoCAD Electrical experience

- You have personally drawn LV switchboard single line diagrams and can show us examples

- You can read an electrical specification and a cable schedule and pick up where they contradict a drawing

- Careful and consistent - on a repeating drawing set, one wrong asset tag copied across 40 buildings is a serious problem

- Good written English, and you raise questions early rather than guessing

- Reliable internet and your own PC capable of running AutoCAD

- Able to work hours that overlap with Perth, Western Australia (AWST, GMT+8) - ideally 8am to 5pm Perth time, which is 8am to 5pm Philippines time



NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED



- Electrical engineering or electrical technology qualification

- Experience with Australian wiring standards (AS/NZS 3000) - we will teach you our standards either way

- Autodesk Vault, or any document/revision control system

- Experience producing drawings for client review and approval cycles



WHAT WE OFFER



- Full-time, long-term, salaried work - this program runs for years, and we want one person who gets fast at it rather than a rotation of freelancers

- Paid Philippine holidays and a 13th month

- Direct work with our engineering manager - no agency in between

- Annual review



RATE



Please tell us your expected monthly rate for full-time work, and we will discuss it. We pay well for someone who gets it right the first time.



HOW TO APPLY - PLEASE READ. WE DO NOT REPLY TO APPLICATIONS THAT SKIP THIS.



1. Put the word BUSBAR at the very top of your application. Applications without it are deleted unread.

2. Send 2-3 examples of single line diagrams or switchboard drawings you personally drew. Remove or black out any client names if you need to. Tell us which parts were yours.

3. In two or three sentences: what is the difference between Form 2b and Form 4b switchboard separation, and why would a drawing call for it?

4. Tell us your AutoCAD version and whether you have used AutoCAD Electrical.

5. Tell us your available start date and the hours you can work in Perth time.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short PAID test drawing - about three to four hours' work, marking up one of our typical sheets for a different site. We pay for that test whether or not we hire you.

title: UGC Content Creator & Social Media Manager — Luxury Travel Brand
description:
ABOUT THE BRAND



We are a luxury travel content brand built around real experiences — adventure, luxury, and leisure across nearly 60 countries. The founder is an experienced traveler with a deep content library, a strong personal brand, and a clear vision. We are growing fast and we need one exceptional person to own the content side completely.



Platforms: Instagram (primary), TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube

Content style: Luxury travel, smart travel strategies, real destination experiences, personal stories

Stage: Active and growing — this is not a startup feeling its way. This is a brand with assets, direction, and momentum.



THE ROLE



The founder provides the assets — footage, photos, travel experiences. You build the vision from there.



This means owning the content calendar, ideating posts from scratch, editing and designing to completion, writing captions, selecting music, researching hashtags, publishing, and tracking performance. You bring the creative direction. You flag what’s needed before it becomes a problem. You work ahead, not behind.



This is not a task-execution role. We are not looking for someone who waits to be told what to do. We need a creative strategist and executor who takes raw assets and turns them into a content plan — and then sees it through to posting without hand-holding.



Hours: 30 hours per week, up to 40 during peak periods

Availability: Must be available during US business hours, approximately 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM EST, for calls and meetings

Rate: $7 USD per hour

Bonuses: Performance bonus tied to first significant brand deal closed. Ongoing raises and bonuses based on results.

Tools: You provide your own tools. Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, and standard scheduling platforms is expected.

Start: Immediate.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1 — Content Strategy & Calendar Ownership



Build the monthly content calendar from scratch — informed by what’s trending, what aligns with the brand pillars (Adventure, Luxury, Leisure), and what will perform on each platform.

Bring ideas proactively. Do not wait to be asked.

Flag asset needs clearly and in advance — never at the last minute.



2 — Content Creation & Editing



Take raw footage and photos provided by the founder and produce polished, on-brand content — Reels, carousels, static posts, TikToks.

Write captions in the founder’s voice. Select music. Research and apply hashtags.

Deliver on time, every time. Fast turnaround is non-negotiable.



3 — Publishing & Performance



Publish content across all platforms — Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube.

Monitor post performance and report back proactively. Flag what’s working and what isn’t — don’t wait to be asked.

Stay ahead of platform trends, algorithm updates, and trending audio.



4 — Brand Partnerships & Outreach



Research hotel, resort, and brand partnership opportunities.

Build polished pitch decks and outreach scripts for US-based brands and properties.

Manage outreach, follow-ups, and partnership pipeline tracking.

Manage brand presence on UGC platforms — Billo, JoinBrands, 
.



5 — Script Writing



Write scripts for Reels and TikToks in the founder’s voice — hooks that stop the scroll, storytelling that holds attention, calls to action that convert.

Adapt scripts across formats — talking head, voiceover, text overlay, carousel flow.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



REQUIRED — Proactive ownership. You do not wait to be told. You bring ideas, flag problems before they happen, and keep the work moving without being nudged. If you need reminders to do your job, this is not the right fit.



REQUIRED — Content strategy experience. You have built content calendars for real brands. You understand what performs, what’s trending, and how to match content to brand voice and platform.



REQUIRED — UGC experience with real brands. You have created and edited UGC content for real brands. You have worked on UGC platforms and have a portfolio that proves it. No portfolio, no consideration.



REQUIRED — US-based client experience. You have worked with US-based clients, understand the market, the platforms, and the pace. This is non-negotiable.



REQUIRED — Caption and script writing in someone else’s voice. You write captions and scripts that sound like the creator, not like a template. You can share examples.



REQUIRED — Availability during US business hours. You must be reachable and available for calls and meetings approximately 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM EST. If you cannot commit to this, do not apply.



REQUIRED — This role is your priority. Other client commitments must not interfere with the quality, timeliness, or attention you bring to this role. We expect to be treated as a priority, not an afterthought. If you are stretched across multiple clients, this is not the right fit.



Attention to detail — you catch inconsistencies before they become problems. You flag when something doesn’t add up and push back when something looks wrong.

Organized and communicative — you tell the founder exactly what you need and when, well in advance. You never go quiet.

Open to feedback — you receive direction, implement it the first time, and don’t repeat the same mistake twice.

Trend awareness — you know what audio is trending before it peaks.

Travel industry understanding — you know the difference between luxury and budget travel, you consume travel content, and you understand what drives booking decisions.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH



Starting rate: $7 USD per hour

Hours: 30 hours per week, up to 40 during peak periods

Brand deal bonus: Bonus tied to the first significant brand partnership closed — specifics discussed at offer stage

Performance bonuses: Ongoing bonuses based on results

Raises: Regular rate reviews based on performance



HOW TO APPLY



We read every application carefully. A generic application will not be considered.



Your application must include:



Introduction — Who you are, what you do best, and why this role is the right fit right now.

Content Strategy Experience (REQUIRED) — Describe a content calendar you built for a brand. What was your process? What were the results?

UGC Experience (REQUIRED) — What UGC work have you done, which brands, and what were the deliverables? Share your portfolio. No portfolio, no consideration.

US Client Experience (REQUIRED) — Which US-based clients have you worked with and what did you produce for them?

Script & Caption Writing (REQUIRED) — Share an example of a script or caption you wrote in someone else’s voice. What was the hook?

Availability (REQUIRED) — Confirm you are available to start immediately and are available 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM EST for calls and meetings.

Other clients — Are you currently working with other clients? How do you manage priorities when deadlines conflict?

The brand question — In 2–3 sentences: what do you think is the single biggest content opportunity for a luxury travel brand right now?

Subject line (REQUIRED) — Your subject line must read exactly: Luxury Travel Brand — Content Creator Application. This is your first attention-to-detail test. Applications without this exact subject line will not be reviewed.



A test task will be required as part of the interview process. It is unpaid and takes approximately 1–2 hours. We take this seriously — we expect you to as well.



GREEN FLAGS



Strong content calendar samples with real results

UGC portfolio with real brands and real deliverables

Captions and scripts that actually sound like a human, not a template

Clear, specific answers — no vague generalities

You reference luxury travel specifically in your application

You catch something in this posting and mention it

You go beyond what we asked for



RED FLAGS



No UGC portfolio or experience

No US client experience

No content calendar or strategy experience

Generic opener with no reference to this role

Vague or evasive answer about other client commitments

Not available during US business hours

Needed to be followed up with more than once during the application process

Took 24+ hours to respond



We are building something real in the luxury travel space.

We need someone who takes ownership, works ahead, and treats this brand like it matters — because it does.

If that’s you, we want to hear from you.

description:

**Full-Time | Remote | Philippines**



**Compensation: $150 USD Weekly Base + Up to $500 Quarterly Performance Bonus**



Hi!



I'm looking for an experienced, creative, highly organized, and results-driven Social Media Manager to join our growing team at Mami Wander Media.



We are a creator media company focused on producing daily short-form content, primarily TikTok Shop affiliate product content, across TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube, and Threads.



I'm looking for someone who understands social media growth, content distribution, audience engagement, and the importance of posting consistently across multiple platforms.



This is NOT a position for someone who simply scrolls social media or occasionally posts content.



I need someone who can take ownership of our daily social media publishing process, keep our content organized, maintain our posting schedules, and help grow our digital presence.



**The most important requirement is that you understand the TikTok Shop affiliate creator ecosystem and know how to manage social media accounts professionally.**



### Your Main Responsibilities

- Manage assigned TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube, and Threads accounts.

- Maintain consistent daily posting across assigned platforms.

- Optimize captions, hashtags, descriptions, and publishing details.

- Ensure all posts are published correctly and on schedule.

- Monitor account health and flag restrictions, warnings, or publishing problems.

- Maintain consistent brand voice and presentation.



**2. TikTok Shop Affiliate Content Coordination**

- Coordinate the posting of approved shoppable product videos.

- Verify product links and product tagging where applicable.

- Track content publishing deadlines and assigned products.

- Coordinate with the content production team on upcoming videos.

- Flag product availability, content compliance, and posting issues.

- Track basic affiliate content performance.

- Schedule posts using approved platform tools.

- Coordinate with the team to ensure content is ready before deadlines.

- Maintain an accurate record of published, pending, and delayed posts.

- Monitor comments, audience interactions, and engagement.

- Respond to approved routine comments and messages within company guidelines.

- Identify trending content formats and relevant growth opportunities.

- Monitor follower growth, views, reach, and engagement.

- Recommend improvements based on performance data.

- Track daily publishing completion.

- Monitor views, reach, engagement, follower growth, and content performance.

- Identify top-performing and underperforming content.

- Prepare daily and weekly performance summaries.

- Recommend content distribution improvements.

- Maintain accurate performance dashboards in Google Sheets or company-approved systems.



**6. Team Communication & Accountability**

- Communicate with the CEO, Executive Assistant, and content team.

- Complete hourly progress check-ins during scheduled work hours.

- Update assigned tasks in Notion or 
.

- Flag missing content, delayed approvals, and technical issues immediately.

- Submit a complete end-of-day performance report.



### Non-Negotiable Requirements



- Proven experience managing multiple social media accounts professionally.

- Strong working knowledge of TikTok Shop affiliate content and the creator ecosystem.

- Experience with TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube Shorts, and Threads.

- Strong understanding of social media algorithms, engagement, and content distribution.

- Experience using Google Workspace and social media scheduling tools.

- Familiarity with Notion, 
, and 
.

- Excellent written English and professional communication.

- Exceptional attention to detail and organization.

- Ability to work independently and meet daily deadlines.

- Reliable attendance and consistent hourly progress updates.

- Stable internet connection, personal computer, and backup internet or power plan.

- Ability to work 8 hours daily during the agreed schedule.



### Compensation & Career Opportunity



- **Base Salary:** $150 USD per week.

- **Quarterly Bonus:** Up to $500 USD based on measurable performance.

- **Maximum Annual Compensation:** $9,800 USD.

- **Employment:** Full-time, long-term remote position.

Quarterly bonuses will be based on posting consistency, accuracy, account management, audience engagement, reporting, and accountability.



### How to Apply



Send your application to:







Include:



1. Your updated resume.

 addresses, and working relationships.

.

We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career while helping grow Mami Wander Media into a successful multi-platform creator media company.

title: E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT
description:
IMPORTANT NOTICE TO APPLICANTS

Attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions are part of our screening process. Each step is clearly outlined, so please read carefully and complete all requirements.

Incomplete applications or those that fail to follow instructions will not be considered.





E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

MORALVE | JOB DESCRIPTION

Department: E-commerce Operations | Reports To: Operations & Supply Chain Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time | Work Arrangement: Remote



POSITION OVERVIEW

MORALVE is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and proactive E-commerce Operations Assistant to support the daily operations of our growing e-commerce business.



This versatile, hands-on role covers marketplace and account health monitoring, inventory tracking, customer service, logistics coordination, data entry, administrative support, and ongoing system and database maintenance.



The primary purpose is to ensure daily operations run smoothly, information remains accurate and current, and recurring tasks are monitored, documented, and completed. The assistant works closely with the Operations & Supply Chain Manager across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.



We value reliability, initiative, follow-through, adaptability, and willingness to learn as much as previous technical experience. As familiarity develops, the role can progress from task execution toward independent ownership of routine workflows, exception identification, and project coordination.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketplace Account Monitoring & Maintenance

• Perform daily and recurring checks across Amazon and other assigned marketplaces.

• Monitor account health, notifications, alerts, warnings, and pending action items.



2. Inventory Monitoring & Maintenance

• Monitor inventory availability and stock health across marketplaces and inventory systems.

• Track replenishments, transfers, inbound activity, and receiving updates.

• Update inventory trackers and compare internal data against marketplace records.



3. Customer Service & Customer Experience Support

• Monitor and respond to routine customer inquiries using established guidelines and templates.

• Support order inquiries, delivery concerns, returns, refunds, and replacements within approved authority.

• Track unresolved cases, document actions, and follow up to closure.

• Identify recurring product or service issues and escalate sensitive or nonstandard cases.



4. Logistics, Shipment & Order Monitoring

• Monitor shipment and logistics updates, communications, and operational notifications.

• Maintain shipment trackers and milestones, including estimated arrival, delivery, and receiving.

• Assist with Amazon FBA, AWD, and other marketplace inbound monitoring.

• Record shipment references and organize supporting documents.

• Follow up on missing routine updates and flag delays or discrepancies.



5. Purchase Order & Supplier Coordination Support

• Maintain purchase order records, production updates, and related tracking systems.

• Monitor supplier communications, completion dates, inspection updates, and outstanding information.

• Collect quotations, documents, and routine supplier information.



6. Data Entry, Database & Tracker Maintenance

• Perform accurate recurring data entry and maintenance in spreadsheets, trackers, and databases.

• Update records using verified
s, reports, marketplace information, and supplier communications.

• Identify duplicate, missing, outdated, or inconsistent data.

• Assist with historical backtracking, cleanup, cross-checking, and reconciliation.

• Follow established data standards, formatting, and naming conventions.



7.
, Communication & Task Management

• Monitor assigned operational inboxes and channels; categorize and label communications.

• Identify and execute routine actions, follow-ups, documentation, and escalation.

• Track outstanding requests and pending responses.

• Communicate updates to internal and external stakeholders as appropriate.



8. Document & File Organization

• Download, rename, categorize, and store operational files according to company standards.

• Organize product, shipment, purchase order, inspection, supplier, and customer service documents.

• Support historical file cleanup and ensure records are traceable to their transactions.



9. Routine Operational & Administrative Support

• Complete assigned daily, weekly, and monthly checklists and maintenance tasks.

• Assist with account checks, reporting, data collection, research, and administrative activities.

• Support routine coordination across departments and evolving business needs.



10. Project Coordination & Process Improvement

• Maintain assigned project boards, task lists, deadlines, and documentation.

• Track deliverables, follow up on action items, and report blockers early.

• Assist with small operational projects and SOP documentation.

• Suggest practical improvements to accuracy, organization, and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Experience in at least 3 areas: : e-commerce operations, virtual assistance, administrative support, customer service, marketplace management, inventory/order management, logistics support, or data entry.

• Working knowledge of Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, sorting, filtering, and organizing data.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, written and verbal English communication.

• Ability to interpret
s, spreadsheets, reports, and operational systems and determine routine next steps.

• Ability to manage recurring responsibilities, follow SOPs, and work independently in a remote environment.

• Reliability, accountability, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn.



Preferred

• Experience with Amazon Seller Central or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with marketplace account health, listings, inventory, orders, and e-commerce customer service.

• Experience with Google Workspace and project tools such as 
, ClickUp, Asana, or Notion.

• Basic familiarity with Amazon FBA/AWD, shipments, purchase orders, and replenishment.

• Experience working with suppliers or logistics providers and maintaining SOPs or operational trackers.



KEY COMPETENCIES

Attention to Detail - Maintains accurate records and recognizes inconsistencies.

Reliability & Consistency - Completes recurring responsibilities on time.

Ownership & Accountability - Takes responsibility and follows tasks to completion.

Proactiveness - Identifies missing information, pending actions, and potential issues.

Problem-Solving - Investigates and proposes possible solutions before escalation.

Learning Agility - Learns new tools and processes quickly.

Organization & Prioritization - Distinguishes urgent issues from routine tasks.

Communication & Follow-Through - Provides timely updates and closes loops.

Adaptability - Supports changing needs across operational functions.

Process Discipline & Judgment - Follows SOPs and recognizes when approval is required.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

• Complete daily, weekly, and monthly responsibilities accurately and on time.

• Keep operational records complete, consistent, and up to date.

• Identify and report marketplace, inventory, customer service, and logistics issues promptly.

• Track open inquiries and action items through resolution.

• Communicate progress, challenges, and blockers proactively.

• Gradually manage assigned recurring workflows with less supervision.



WORK SCHEDULE & BENEFITS

Work Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Work Arrangement: Remote

13th Month Pay: Provided annually

Paid Holidays: Paid Philippine Regular and Special Non-Working Holidays

Paid Time Off (PTO): 5 paid leave days per year

Team Environment: Collaborative and supportive remote team

Professional Growth: Hands-on exposure to e-commerce tools and operations



GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

Initially, the role focuses on learning MORALVE's systems, completing recurring tasks accurately, and maintaining reliable records. With demonstrated consistency, accountability, and judgment, the assistant may progress toward independent ownership of operational processes, advanced marketplace and inventory responsibilities, reporting and reconciliation, workflow improvement, and cross-functional project coordination.





If these resonate with you, we’d love to hear from you!

Ready to apply?

Click (or copy the link to your browser) below to get started:

Apply Here 👉 Initial Applicant Form : 



Our application process includes a few steps to help us get to know you better, including some initial questions, online assessments, and a short video introduction.

We recommend setting aside enough time to complete everything in one go. Please read the instructions carefully and make sure all required information is submitted.



Having trouble accessing the form? Feel free to
 us at 
 and we'll be happy to assist.



Thank you for your interest in joining MORALVE! We appreciate the time and effort you're putting into your application and look forward to learning more about you.

title: Retention & Lifecycle Marketing Manager - DTC brand
description:
We are looking for a full-time Retention & Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own and improve retention for our DTC ecommerce brand.

This is not a pure execution role. We need someone who can analyze customer behavior, identify why customers are not repurchasing, develop a prioritized retention strategy, and implement it through
, SMS, segmentation, testing, and lifecycle optimization.



What You’ll Do

- Own the end-to-end retention and lifecycle strategy across
, SMS, Shopify, Klaviyo, and key website touchpoints.

- Develop and optimize the complete customer journey, including post-purchase experience, repeat purchase, cross-sell, replenishment, reactivation, loyalty, rewards, referral, subscription, and VIP programs.

- Analyze customer, product, cohort, and channel data to identify why customers repurchase, delay, or churn—and prioritize the highest-impact opportunities.

- Plan and execute retention campaigns, lifecycle automations, segmentation, personalization, offers, and testing.

- Coordinate copy, creative, implementation, QA, deliverability, and reporting to ensure initiatives are launched correctly and continuously improved.

- Work closely with ecommerce, paid media, creative, and customer service teams to create a connected retention system across the business.



What We’re Looking For

- Proven retention or lifecycle marketing experience with DTC/ecommerce brands.

- Strong working knowledge of Shopify, Klaviyo,
, and SMS.

- Experience with post-purchase journeys, loyalty or rewards programs, VIP programs, subscriptions, and website retention initiatives.

- Ability to combine strategy, analytics, customer psychology, copy, and hands-on implementation.

- Strong understanding of repeat purchase rate, customer lifetime value, segmentation, testing, and deliverability.

- Able to independently identify problems, prioritize opportunities, and take ownership of results.

- Strong written and spoken English.



Experience with beauty, skincare, cosmetics, supplements, or other repeat-purchase products is a plus.



This role is not suitable for someone whose experience is mainly designing templates, scheduling campaigns, or implementing strategies created by others.





How to Apply



Please answer all questions below in the same numbered format. Applications that do not follow these instructions or provide incomplete answers will not be reviewed.



1. Share your CV

2. What is your current availability? Are you looking for a full-time position or fractional/freelance work? If currently employed, when could you start?

3. Which DTC ecommerce brands or agencies have you supported? For each relevant example, briefly explain your role and what you personally owned. Keep it concise.

4. What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time role

5. Which parts can you personally execute: strategy, data analysis, copywriting, Klaviyo building, segmentation, QA, design direction, deliverability, and reporting?

6. Have you worked on post-purchase, loyalty, rewards, referral, subscription, or VIP programs? Describe one example and your personal contribution.

title: AI Video Editor (Direct Response Ads)
description:
We're a fast-growing DTC supplement brand running video ads on Meta, mainly for women 50+. We produce our ads with AI, and we're looking for an AI video editor who can turn scripts into scroll-stopping ads that sell.



What you'll do

- Turn approved scripts into finished video ads using AI tools: generating scenes and characters, image-to-video, AI voiceover, lip-sync, music and sound effects

- Keep characters and the product looking consistent from shot to shot

- Edit for direct response: strong hook in the first 3 seconds, fast pacing, clear captions, offer card at the end

- Deliver 9:16 and 4:5 versions of every ad

- Make hook variations of winning ads so we can test them



What we're looking for

- Proven experience making AI-generated video, not just editing real footage

- An eye for what looks real vs. what looks "AI"

- Experience with ads for supplements, skincare or health products is a big plus

- Fast turnaround and the ability to take feedback and revise quickly

- Strong English for understanding scripts and on-screen text



Tools

All AI tools and subscriptions are provided. You just need your skills and a solid editing setup.



How to apply

Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed. Please send:

1. Your portfolio, with links to AI video ads you have made

2. Which AI tools you have used and what you made with them

3. Your rate per finished minute of video

4. Your usual turnaround time for a 1-2 minute ad

description:
# Virtual Assistant – Short-Form Video Editing & Content Planning



**Location:** Remote  

**Schedule:** Part-time initially, with the potential to transition to full-time employment as content volume and business needs grow.



## About the Role



I’m looking for a creative, organized, and reliable virtual assistant to help me improve my content quality and post consistently on TikTok and Instagram Reels.



Your main focus will be editing engaging short-form videos and managing a clear content calendar that outlines **what to post, when to post, and what needs to be prepared**. I’m looking for someone who can bring ideas, take initiative, and help turn raw footage into a steady flow of polished content while keeping my personality and voice at the center.



## Key Responsibilities



### Short-Form Video Editing

- Turn raw footage into polished videos for TikTok and Instagram Reels.

- Edit for strong opening hooks, clear storytelling, and engaging pacing.

- Add accurate captions, suitable music, transitions, and graphics where they improve the video.

- Maintain a consistent visual style across content.

- Adapt videos for each platform, keeping text and key visuals clear of platform interface elements.

- Incorporate feedback and deliver edits by agreed deadlines.

- Organize footage, drafts, and final files so everything is easy to find.



### Content Planning & Calendar Management

- Create and maintain a weekly and monthly content calendar.

- Specify each post’s topic, platform, planned posting date and time, caption, and production status.

- Plan a balanced mix of content around agreed themes and goals.

- Identify footage that can be repurposed into multiple posts.

- Prepare filming prompts and shot lists so I know what to record next.

- Flag missing footage, upcoming deadlines, and opportunities to prepare content in batches.

- Research relevant trends and suggest ideas that fit my audience and style.

- Prepare posts for approval and, once authorized, schedule or publish them.

- Review available performance data and recommend adjustments to topics, formats, and posting times.



## Who You Are



- You have experience editing short-form videos and can share examples of your work.

- You understand how to create compelling hooks, readable captions, and videos that hold viewers’ attention.

- You are comfortable using tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software.

- You can manage a content calendar using tools such as Google Sheets, Notion, Trello, or Asana.

- You write clear English and proofread captions carefully.

- You are organized, communicate proactively, and follow through on deadlines.

- You can work independently while asking thoughtful questions when direction is needed.

- You can adapt to my voice and style and offer constructive creative suggestions.

- You handle unpublished content and account access confidentially.



## Nice to Have



- Experience supporting a personal brand or content creator.

- Familiarity with TikTok and Instagram analytics.

- Experience with content strategy, caption writing, and social media scheduling tools.

- Examples of how you have helped a creator improve consistency or audience engagement.



## Working Arrangement



This role will begin part-time, with hours, video volume, turnaround expectations, and compensation agreed before starting.



As the workload grows, there may be an opportunity to move into full-time employment. This will depend on business needs, performance, and mutual agreement.



We’ll start by agreeing on an editing style, a realistic posting schedule, and a clear process for footage handoff, feedback, and approvals. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a **paid trial project**.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. A brief introduction explaining your relevant experience and why this role interests you.

2. Links to three to five short-form videos you have edited, with a brief explanation of your contribution.

3. A sample content calendar, using fictional content or removing confidential client information.

4. Your preferred editing and planning tools.

5. Your part-time availability, time zone, and earliest start date.

6. 

7. Your typical turnaround time and the number of videos you could realistically manage within your proposed hours.





**Please also answer:** If I gave you a folder of unedited footage and several content ideas, how would you turn them into a week of ready-to-post content?



I’m looking for a long-term collaborator who can help me create better content, stay organized, and build a consistent posting routine.

title: Senior US Project and Sales Manager
description:
About the role

Wolf IQ Group is hiring a full-time senior technical and project lead for the US market: the person our US account executives bring into every sales call, who then carries the project through design concept, build and launch.

• Title: Senior US Project and Sales Manager (full-time)

• Market: United States (Quix Sites)

• Location: Remote, Philippines-based on US hours

• Reports to: the CEO

• Works closely with: US AEs, Sales Operations Manager, the AU project manager (project management and dev scheduling)



Why this role is different

• You'll be on every US sales call. Our US AEs lay out proposals live, and the technical questions land with you.

• You take over US design concepts, US project management, US customer calls and Q&A from the US AEs

• Wolf IQ Group is profitable and growing: a 20+ person team across Australia, the United States and the Philippines, helping 500+ businesses win online. 

• Annual team offsite.



What you will do

About 70% of the role is technical (project management and website development) and 30% is sales. Responsibilities below are adapted from the AU project manager's current daily and weekly list, with the US pieces moving to this role.



Sales calls and proposals

• Join every US sales call with the US AEs. Answer technical questions live and walk prospects through scope, timelines and process.

• Build design concepts for US prospects.

• Draft quotes, proposals and timelines in HubSpot, and write follow-up
s on stalled deals.

• Be the first line for the US AEs' questions.

• Build relationships with US customers over time, reach out to them as they come to trust you, and win sales where it fits.



US customer delivery

• Own every active US project, each with a named owner. Reply to customer
s on updates, approvals, scope and escalations.

• Run kickoffs, design reviews and weekly customer syncs.

• Chase overdue feedback, content, access and approvals. Set expectations and push back on timelines when needed.

• Onboard new customers: onboarding forms, sitemap and content checklists, payment check before go-live.

• Manage launches: readiness checks, backups, go-live and handover
s.

• Handle post-launch fixes and clean-ups, and own website concepts, scoping, templates and handover for US customers.



Dev and design coordination

• Write briefs and set internal deadlines with review buffers. Book developer time through or with the AU project manager in ClickUp (see the next section).

• Answer dev questions, check build progress and chase ETAs.

• QA builds and designs before they reach the customer: desktop, mobile, forms, content and SEO basics.



Hands-on work

• Build and fix pages on custom websites, WordPress, Shopify and Wix yourself when needed.

• Debug live sites (plugins, forms, layouts, redirects, broken features) and jump in when a customer site goes down, then coordinate the devs and update the customer.

• Coordinate DNS changes, domain connections and site or domain transfers.

• Use AI tools daily (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and others) for drafting, QA, research, quotes and reporting.



Reporting and process

• Keep ClickUp current as the source of truth for US projects, plus a US project dashboard.

• Join the morning stand-up and run a weekly PM sync with the CEO.

• Improve the process as you go: end-of-day update standards, AI workflows, launch checklists, and a shared Q&A bank for the US team.



How this role works with the AU team

All dev and design work for US customers goes through or with the AU project manager in ClickUp, so AU and US deadlines are planned together and customers are only promised dates the developers can meet.

• Dev time: our developers are well booked on AU work, and that is the aim. This role books dev time through the AU project manager to start, then works with them as the process settles, and may book independently in future. It never takes work from developers without a plan.

• Questions from the US AEs: you are the first line. Where an answer already exists, it goes in a shared Q&A bank, kept with the Sales Operations Manager and the Operations Manager, so the same question is not answered twice. The CEO is the last resort.

• What stays with the AU project manager: AU delivery, customer support and developer scheduling.

• What moves to this role: US design concepts, US project management, US customer calls and Q&A from the US AEs.



What you bring

We are looking for a senior hire: ideally 5 to 10+ years of experience, comfortable on a sales call and in the weeds of a build.

• US market experience: building trust and communicating with US business owners, on live calls and in writing.

• Project management experience across web design and web development. You have run customer projects end to end.

• Highly proficient technically: you set up skills, automations and integrations, and you are not afraid of a broken plugin or a DNS record.

• Familiarity with ClickUp or a similar project management tool.

• Strong written and spoken English, and the judgment to set expectations and push back on timelines.

• Responsive: quick to reply to the US AEs, prospects and customers.

• Organised: every project, deadline and handover has a clear owner and date.

• A strong eye for design, able to build and judge design concepts.

• Works well under pressure.

• Able to work US Pacific hours, on the same schedule as the US AEs.



Bonus experience

None of these are required, but each helps on day one.

• Hands-on custom builds in Wix, Shopify or WordPress, plus design concept work.

• HubSpot (deals, quotes, pipeline) and ClickUp, including ClickUp AI.

• Daily use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini to draft, QA and speed up customer work.

• SEO or Google Ads experience.

• DNS, domain and site migration experience.

• Prior work with an agency selling websites and care plans to small businesses.



Hours, pay and reporting

• Hours: full-time, 40 hours a week, on US Pacific hours in line with the US AEs. US prospect meetings typically start around 4 AM Philippines time, so the exact schedule is to be confirmed by Sales Operations.

• Pay: base salary plus commission on deals the role closes, the same principle as the US AEs. Proposed base: A$1,800 to A$2,500 per month, plus commission. Final amount to be confirmed by the CEO before posting.

• Reports to: the CEO. Nobody reports into this role for now. Whether that changes later is not d
.

• Location: remote, Philippines-based on US hours.



To confirm you've read the entire job description, please respond with the subject line "Ready to manage".

Be sure to include the following in your application:

- Resume

- A short note (3–5 sentences) describing your prior experience

- Photo of your work area

title: Dental Biller
description:
We're a dental billing company that manages the financial revenue cycle of a dental practice by preparing and submitting insurance claims, verifying patient benefits, posting payments, and resolving denials.



Core Responsibilities

• Insurance Verification & Pre-Authorizations: Confirm patient eligibility, coverage maximums, deductibles, and pre-authorizations 48 to 72 hours before scheduled appointments.



• Payment Posting & Reconciliation: Post insurance and patient payments accurately, process Explanations of Benefits (EOBs), and manage accounts receivable (AR).



• Denials & Appeals Management: Track aging reports, investigate unpaid or denied claims, and submit formal appeals to insurance companies.



• Patient Billing & Communication: Generate patient statements, answer financial inquiries, and set up payment plans for out-of-pocket balances.



• Compliance: Maintain strict adherence to HIPAA regulations and Business Associate Agreements (BAAs).



MUST also know how to read x-rays and know tooth numbers. EXPERIENCED ONLY !

title: Luxury Transportation Dispatcher / Reservations Specialist — US Overnight
description:

Individual shifts and working days will be agreed before hiring. Philippine working hours will shift by one hour when New York changes its clocks.



**What you’ll do**



- Manage reservations and keep trip details accurate.

- Track flights, confirm pickups, and monitor active trips.

- Handle customer calls,
s, and messages professionally.

- Resolve late-driver situations, flight changes, and pickup confusion.

- Document issues and provide clear shift handovers.



**What we’re looking for**



- Previous transportation dispatch or reservations experience.

- Strong preference for limousine, black-car, or luxury chauffeur experience.

- Limo Anywhere experience strongly preferred; tell us which systems you’ve used.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist (Pinterest, Email Marketing, Shopify)
description:

title: Part Time Video Editor: Weekly Show to YouTube Videos and Captioned Clips
description:
FLXSPACE is a creator studio in Philadelphia (flxspace.vip) for music, podcasts and photo. Every week we film a live show for creators and entrepreneurs. You turn that one recording into YouTube videos and short captioned clips. We use the clips in sales, so they matter.



THE WEEKLY WORK

• You get 1 recording on show day: about 2 hours, 1080p, with chapter markers already in.

• Cut 4 long videos at the markers: 3 topic segments and 1 Q&A. Add our intro, outro and ad to each.

• Cut 12 vertical clips, 3 from each long video, with captions. The hook lands in the first 3 seconds.

• Upload the 4 long videos to our YouTube channel in order. We write the titles and add the thumbnails.

• Deliver everything within 3 days of getting the recording.



PAY

• $50 a week flat for the weekly work, paid every week through OnlineJobs EasyPay.

• A $15 paid test before we hire, paid whether or not we hire you.

• The first 30 days are a trial, paid weekly. Rate review at 90 days.

• Start: week of November 23, 2026.



YOU HAVE

• At least 1 year editing YouTube videos and short form clips for clients.

• Your own computer that edits 1080p smoothly. Premiere Pro preferred; CapCut is fine for clips.

• Fast, stable internet. You will download about 10 to 20 GB a week.

• A backup for power or internet outages.

• Clear written English and replies within 24 hours.

• Comfort working on your own schedule. We are 13 hours behind Manila, so most work is async.



HOW TO APPLY

We only read applications that follow these steps.

1. Start your message with: FLX CUT

2. Links to 2 long videos and 3 short clips you edited, and what you did on each.

3. The software you use for long videos and for captions.

4. How many hours a week you can give us, and how many clients you have now.

5. Your internet speed (a speedtest link) and your backup if the power or internet goes down.

title: SEO & AI Search Optimization Specialist (Google, ChatGPT, Gemini)

title: Video Editor for B2C Info-Business YouTube, Ads & VSLs
description:
About Us

We work with B2C info businesses (coaches, course creators, and education-based brands) to grow their YouTube channels and paid acquisition. Our focus isn't chasing viral views — it's building watch time, trust, and conversions that turn viewers into customers, leads, and buyers. We're looking for a long-term editor who understands that difference and can move fluidly between content types.



INSPO OF THE STYLE WE ARE LOOKING FOR:









The Role

We need a versatile video editor who is genuinely strong across styles — long-form YouTube, short-form clips, paid ad creatives, and VSLs (Video Sales Letters). You'll take raw footage (talking-head, screen recordings, interviews, UGC-style clips) and turn it into whatever format the project calls for, always built around retention and conversion, not vanity metrics.



Heads up on how this starts: we're beginning with a small, low-volume workload as a trial run. This isn't a red flag on the role — it's how we bring everyone in. Once we see the quality and reliability of your work and more trust is built, expect to receive more work on a consistent basis.



What You'll Be Doing



Editing long-form YouTube videos (typically 10-25 minutes) for pacing, clarity, and retention

Cutting short-form content (Shorts/Reels/TikTok-style clips), often repurposed from long-form footage

Editing VSLs — structuring hooks, pain points, proof, and calls-to-action to move a viewer toward a buying decision

Editing paid ad creatives (Meta/YouTube/TikTok ads) built to convert, not just entertain

Adding b-roll, captions/subtitles, sound design, music, and motion graphics where it serves the content — not for flash

Following brand guidelines and keeping a consistent visual style across formats and channels

Organizing and managing project files/assets so nothing gets lost between revisions

Taking notes/feedback and turning revisions around quickly and without back-and-forth



What We're Looking For



Proven range across long-form YouTube AND short-form content — please only apply if you're genuinely strong at both, not one with the other as an afterthought

Real experience editing VSLs and/or direct-response ad creatives — you understand hooks, pacing toward a CTA, and structuring for persuasion, not just aesthetics

Strong sense of pacing and storytelling for content meant to build trust and drive action, across every format

Comfortable with captions, basic color correction, audio cleanup, and motion graphics/text animation

Understanding of what makes B2C/coaching/course-style content convert (clarity, credibility, calls-to-action) vs. what makes it "viral" — we care about the former

Reliable communicator, meets deadlines, takes direction well on revisions

Strong English communication skills

Comfortable starting with a lighter initial workload that grows as trust and consistency are established



Nice to Have



Experience editing for coaches, consultants, course creators, or other info-business/education-based brands specifically

Experience with AI tools for editing efficiency (transcription, rough cuts, etc.)

Basic understanding of YouTube SEO (titles, descriptions, tags)

Direct response / performance marketing background (you know what a good ad "feels" like, not just what looks good)

Basic graphic design skills (not required, but a plus if you can also help with simple visual assets)



To Apply

Please send:



A portfolio/demo reel that shows range — long-form YouTube, short-form, and at least one VSL or ad example. We want to see all of it, not just your best format

Your typical turnaround time per video/project

Your rate (open to proposals — tell us how you'd structure it: per video, hourly, or monthly retainer). Note that we're starting with a lower volume and scaling based on quality, so flexibility on early workload is a plus



We're looking to build a long-term working relationship, not a one-off gig. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: YouTube Thumbnail & Graphic Designer for B2C Info-Business Channels

We work with B2C info businesses (coaches, course creators, and education-based brands) to grow their YouTube channels and paid acquisition. We're looking for a designer who understands that a thumbnail's job is to earn the click while staying true to the brand, not just look flashy.



INSPO OF THE STYLE WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

Heads up on how this starts: we're beginning with a small, low-volume workload as a trial run. This isn't a red flag on the role — it's how we bring everyone in. Once we see the quality and reliability of your work and more trust is built, expect to receive more work on a consistent basis.



What You'll Be Doing



Designing custom YouTube thumbnails for long-form videos — high-CTR, on-brand, and tailored to what performs in the info-business/coaching space

Iterating on thumbnail concepts based on performance data or feedback (not just "make it pop," but understanding why something clicks)

Keeping a consistent visual identity across a channel's thumbnails so the brand is instantly recognizable

Organizing and naming files clearly so assets are easy to find and reuse

Taking notes/feedback and turning revisions around quickly and without back-and-forth



What We're Looking For



Proven experience designing YouTube thumbnails specifically — not just general graphic design with no YouTube portfolio

An eye for what drives clicks in the B2C/coaching/course-creator space: clear value proposition, strong facial expressions/emotion, legible text, and contrast — without looking clickbait-y or cheap

Strong skills in Photoshop, Canva, or similar design tools

Understanding of what makes content convert (clarity, credibility, curiosity) vs. what's just "viral bait" — we care about the former

Ability to work from a brand style guide and keep visual consistency across many thumbnails over time

Reliable communicator, meets deadlines, takes direction well on revisions

Strong English communication skills

Comfortable starting with a lighter initial workload that grows as trust and consistency are established



Nice to Have



Experience designing for coaches, consultants, course creators, or other info-business/education-based brands specifically

title: Hiring: Experienced YouTube Bodycam Video Editor | Long-Form Crime & Police Footage
description:
Hiring: Experienced YouTube Bodycam Video Editor | Long-Form Crime & Police Footage



We are looking for a skilled, creative video editor for a YouTube channel focused on real police bodycam footage, high-intensity encounters, unusual arrests, pursuits, and compelling law enforcement incidents.



Our goal is to transform raw police footage into engaging, professionally edited videos that keep viewers watching from beginning to end.



Editing Style Reference: Midwest Safety (YouTube)



Please review videos from the YouTube channel Midwest Safety before applying.



We are looking for a similar standard of editing, particularly:



- Strong opening hooks: Capture attention within the first 15–30 seconds using the most compelling moments of the incident.

- Excellent pacing: Remove unnecessary downtime, repetitive dialogue, uneventful driving, and lengthy pauses without sacrificing important context.

- Compelling storytelling: Present events in a logical, engaging sequence that builds curiosity and anticipation.

- Clean, professional editing: Use effective cuts, strategic zoom-ins, camera transitions, and well-timed visual emphasis.

- Clear audio and subtitles: Make police dialogue, suspect interactions, and radio communications easy to follow.

- Informative on-screen context: Introduce relevant background information, incident details, and case outcomes when supported by reliable sources.



We want the same level of viewer engagement and professionalism while developing our own recognizable channel identity.



What You Will Do



1. Transform Raw Bodycam Footage into Engaging Videos



- Edit raw police bodycam and dashcam recordings into compelling 15–25-minute YouTube videos, depending on the available footage.

- Identify the most interesting moments and structure the video around them.

- Eliminate unnecessary footage while preserving important dialogue and events.

- Create strong introductions, smooth transitions, and satisfying conclusions.



2. Build Suspense and Maintain Viewer Retention



- Use strategic cuts, camera zooms, subtle sound effects, and music where appropriate.

- Build anticipation around pursuits, confrontations, escapes, arrests, and unexpected developments.

- Maintain natural tension without excessive effects or misleading editing.



3. Professional Audio Editing



- Improve unclear dialogue where technically possible.

- Balance police radios, dispatch communications, environmental sounds, and conversations.

- Reduce distracting background noise.

- Incorporate subtle background music and sound design without overpowering the original footage.



4. Subtitles, Graphics & Context



- Add accurate, easy-to-read subtitles during important conversations.

- Highlight key statements and relevant details.

- Incorporate professional text overlays, timelines, maps, or case information where useful.

- Clearly distinguish verified facts from allegations or disputed claims.



5. YouTube Compliance & Quality Control



- Apply appropriate blurring to sensitive footage, personal information, minors, and graphic content.

- Understand YouTube's advertiser-friendly content guidelines.

- Avoid unnecessary graphic imagery, misleading effects, and sensationalized representations.

- Deliver polished videos ready for YouTube publication.



Requirements



- Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos, preferably police bodycam, true crime, or investigative content.

- Strong understanding of YouTube audience retention and storytelling.

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or comparable professional editing software.

- Excellent English comprehension, including fast conversations, accents, police terminology, and difficult audio.

- Strong audio editing, captioning, and visual storytelling skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines.

- Excellent attention to detail and factual accuracy.



 Project Details



- Video length: Approximately 15–25 minutes, depending on the incident.

- Content provided: Original bodycam/dashcam footage and available case information.

- Work: Ongoing opportunities for the right editor.

- Compensation: Please provide your rate per completed video.

- Turnaround: Please indicate your typical delivery time.

SAFETY RIDE

Applications without relevant portfolio examples or the required opening phrase may not be considered.

title: YouTube Scriptwriter — Unexplained Sightings & Mysteries
description:
I’m looking for an excellent, independent writer to create engaging YouTube scripts about unusual encounters, strange sightings, and unexplained events.



For examples of the writing quality I’m looking for—simple language, conversational delivery, and storytelling that’s extremely easy to follow—see:



• Carolina Case Files: 

• Lighthouse Mysteries: 

• MrBallen: 



PAY & DETAILS



• $100 USD per script, including research.

• 3,000–3,600 words per script.

• Freelance position with potential for ongoing work.

• I’ll provide the topic and writing guidelines for each assignment.



INDEPENDENT WORK



You must handle each script independently, including research, fact-checking, structure, writing, and proofreading.



Submit a finished script that I can narrate as written. I should not need to rewrite sentences, simplify the language, correct factual errors, or restructure the story.



The purpose of this position is to take scriptwriting off my plate. If I have to revise your work, this arrangement does not make sense for me. You need to understand the guidelines and consistently deliver finished scripts independently.



TOPICS



Strange sightings, unexplained events, and unusual encounters. No true crime. Choose stories with safe outcomes for everyone involved.



THE WRITING



Scripts must be extremely easy to follow, engaging, and natural when read aloud. Write the way you would tell a friend a fascinating story.



Absolutely no flowery language. None. No poetic descriptions, elaborate metaphors, or sentences dressed up to sound impressive.



For example:



• Don’t write: “An eerie silence draped itself over the sleepy town.”

Write: “The town was quiet.”



• Don’t write: “The moon cast its silver veil across the lonely stretch of asphalt.”

Write: “The moon lit the road.”



• Don’t write: “An icy wave of terror gripped him as he gazed upon the mysterious figure.”

Write: “He was frightened when he saw the figure.”



The writing must not sound AI-generated at all. No robotic phrasing, generic suspense lines, awkward transitions, or repeated points.



I want a strong opening, events presented in a clear order, and interesting details that hold the listener’s attention. Build interest through what actually happened.



Research each topic carefully, provide source links, and distinguish documented facts from witness accounts or speculation. Do not invent details or dialogue. Include pronunciation guides in parentheses for unfamiliar names and places.



TO APPLY



Use Ghost as the subject line of your application and include:



1. Why you would be a good fit, including any relevant writing experience.

2. At least one existing writing sample. Multiple samples are preferred.

3. Links to published videos using your writing, if available, and your role in creating them.

4. Your usual turnaround time for a 3,000–3,600-word script.



I’d like to work with a dependable writer over the long term.

title: Crochet Artist – Make & Test Amigurumi Patterns ($15 per pattern)
description:
Hi! I run a small online shop that sells crochet patterns (amigurumi: cute stuffed animals and toys). I'm looking for a crochet artist who can crochet our toys by hand and turn each one into a pattern that really works.



HOW IT WORKS

For every project I send you a starting kit:

- a draft pattern made digitally (written step-by-step instructions, rounds and stitch counts)

- pictures of the finished toy and of each piece



Your job is to:

1. Crochet the toy by hand, following the draft.

2. Fix and improve the pattern: correct stitch counts, rounds, colors, assembly steps, anything that doesn't work or isn't clear. You can also change the design if it makes the toy better – use the draft as inspiration, the final pattern must be yours and work 100%.

3. Send back the corrected written pattern (Google Doc or Word is fine) with notes on what you changed.

4. Send real photos of the finished toy (natural light, not edited) and a few progress photos of the main steps.



PAY

- $15 USD per finished pattern (toy made + corrected pattern + photos).

- Paid per project, after delivery.

- Steady work: we have many patterns waiting. Good people get a new project every week, and we can move to a monthly rate later.



YOU ARE A GOOD FIT IF

- You have crocheted amigurumi before (please show us photos of toys you made).

- You can read and write patterns in US terms (sc, inc, dec, magic ring, rounds).

- You notice when a stitch count is off and you know how to fix it.

- You have yarn, hooks and stuffing at home, and a phone that takes clear photos.

- You communicate well in English and meet deadlines.



TO APPLY (about 5 minutes, mostly tick boxes)

1. Fill in this short form: 

   It includes the link to your portfolio and an example of our patterns.

2. Then send me a message here that starts with the word "BUNNY".



Already applied before this update? No need to do anything, we have your application.



Applications without the form won't be considered. Thank you!

title: Real Estate Cold Caller
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME AND A VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING*****



Commercial Real Estate Outreach Specialist



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Pacific Time, with a 30-minute break



Job Overview:

We are seeking a proactive and results-driven Commercial Real Estate Outreach Specialist to support a Senior Vice President specializing in commercial real estate transactions across Southern California. The role focuses on outbound cold calling, prospecting, and relationship building with commercial property owners to identify potential sales and leasing opportunities and schedule appointments.



The ideal candidate has excellent spoken English, strong communication skills, and experience in cold calling or appointment setting. This role requires consistent daily outreach, accurate CRM management, and the ability to engage property owners professionally. Familiarity with commercial real estate research platforms such as CoStar, LoopNet, and Reonomy, along with skip-tracing tools and CRM systems, is highly desirable.



Key Responsibilities:

* Conduct daily outbound calls to commercial property owners to identify potential selling or leasing opportunities and schedule appointments for the Senior Vice President.

* Contact property owners and nearby businesses to promote new commercial property listings for sale or lease.

* Research commercial properties, ownership records, and contact information using CoStar, LoopNet, county property records, Reonomy, and skip-tracing tools.

* Maintain accurate CRM records of calls, conversations, prospect status, and follow-up activities, ensuring contact lists remain organized and up to date.

* Follow up with prospective property owners according to an established schedule to nurture leads and identify future opportunities.

* Review calling lists against applicable Do Not Call (DNC) lists and comply with relevant telemarketing regulations.

* Submit end-of-day reports summarizing call volume, conversations, prospect responses, and appointments booked.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Excellent spoken English, with clear pronunciation, strong fluency, and a natural, professional conversational style. Verbal communication skills are the top priority.

* At least one year of experience in outbound calling, cold calling, telemarketing, lead generation, or appointment setting; real estate experience is preferred.

* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport with business owners, handle rejection professionally, and maintain engaging conversations.

* Basic knowledge of commercial real estate terminology, including cap rates, triple-net (NNN) leases, square footage, and sales and leasing transactions, or the ability to learn quickly.

* Experience with CoStar, LoopNet, or Reonomy is highly preferred.

* Familiarity with CRM systems, sales dialers, contact databases, and skip-tracing tools.

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage daily call targets and follow-up schedules independently.

* Understanding of Do Not Call (DNC) requirements and applicable outbound calling regulations.

* Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a quality headset.

* Experience supporting U.S. commercial real estate brokers or property management teams is an advantage.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.
